notes.title: Patch Notes v. 1.1.8307.0
notes.content:
[h3][b]Greetings, mercenaries.[/b][/h3]

This update releases to all platforms, PC, Mac, on Steam, Epic & GoG, but also on Xbox, Nintendo Switch and Playstation.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[h3][b]NEW ADDITION[/b][/h3]

Polish language is finally available for everyone to enjoy Gloomhaven in!


[h3][b]BUGFIXES[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Network version is synchronized with all consoles. It should greatly smooth out crossplay. 
[*]Fixed desyncs in combat in crossplay multiplayer between PC and Consoles during performing action while other player scrolls initiative line 
[*]Fixed softlock in Multiplayer when client levels up mercenary and host gets rewards in Trainer in Guildmaster mode 
[*]Fixed Mana Potion incorrect behaviour when toggling on/off 
[*]Minor UI fixes[/list]
[h3][b]ADDITIONAL CHANGES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]We have officially merged the Mac branch with the default branch. This means that all Mac players will now be playing the latest version on the default branch alongside all other PC players. You should not notice any changes in gameplay as a result of this merge.

[*]In addition, we will be closing the open beta branch on Thursday, January 18th at 11:00 AM CEST. This is because we now have a newer, more stable version of Gloomhaven available. Deleting the old beta branch will help to reduce the number of potential bugs that could occur from cross-versioning.

[*]If you would like to keep playing the older version of Gloomhaven, you can still access it by staying on or switching to the "V28009" branch.

[*]Please note that neither the "open beta" branch nor the "V28009" branch are compatible with the current and updated "default" branch. This means that you will not be able to switch back from the "open beta" branch nor the "V28009" branch to the default branch without losing your progress.

[list][*]For those still playing on the open beta branch and willing to go to the V28009 branch to keep their saves, you will have to move your save FROM: [i][b]C:\Users\username\AppData\LocalLow\FlamingFowlStudios\Gloomhaven\GloomSavesOpenBeta[/b][/i]
TO: [i][b]C:\Users\username\AppData\LocalLow\FlamingFowlStudios\Gloomhaven\GloomSaves[/b][/i]

[*]To access the V28009 branch, follow these steps:

[olist][*]Open the Steam client.
[*]Click on the "Library" tab.
[*]Right-click on "Gloomhaven" and select "Properties".
[*]Click on the "Betas" tab.
[*]In the "Beta participation" field, select "V28009".
[*]Click on the "Close" button.
[*]The game will now be updated to the "V28009" branch.[/olist][/list][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1.7944.0
notes.content:
[h3][b]Salutations, Gloomhaveners![/b][/h3]

This update releases to PC and Mac (on Steam & GoG) while Xbox and Playstation players also get an update whose content will be shared both on our [url=https://discord.gg/gloomhaven]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/GloomhavenGame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/GloomhavenGame]Facebook[/url] pages.

We tackled many of the bugs you reported to us, so once again, we are thanking you for your help!
This update is rolling out on both the main branch and the mac_open_beta one.

Switch players were already one update ahead of everyone, so this update should put you all back on the same version and solve most of the cross-play issues you have been experiencing.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[h3][b]BUGFIXES[/b][/h3]

[list][*]Network version is synchronized with all consoles. It should greatly smooth out crossplay. 
[*]Fixed bug in Multiplayer in reward distribution after Scenario 84.
[*]Fixed max amount of players that could join the session in Multiplayer during a scenario where there was no merc in play available for them.
[i]Developer note: [/i]The bug allowed a third player to join the session in an already started scenario where only 2 mercenaries were in play which caused a lock up until one of them leaves.
[*]Now card abilities that allow mercenaries to set a trap allow player to Undo the ability selection.
[*]Fixed bug with Gold pieces remaining in doorways after looting it.
[*]Fixed bug that showed player after victory in Campaign scenario that a new perk was available when it wasn’t.
[*]Minor UI fixes.
[*]Triangles: [spoiler] Malleable Evocation - fixed work of Air consumption. [/spoiler]
[*]Cthulhu: [spoiler] when using the Grim Bargain top ability, now selection of enemies is shown on Confirm Targets. [/spoiler]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[h3][b]ADDITIONAL INFO[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*]Polish language will be added in the next update!
[*]If any XBS happen to be here, just a quick heads-up: on XBS, there's this occasional bug leading to random crashes (noticed recently). It seems to be an infrequent initialization glitch. If you face it, here is a quick fix: disconnect, restart the console, and relaunch the game.[/list]

[h3]Until next time, mercenaries![/h3]

notes.title: Update v. 1.1.7560.0
notes.content:
[h3]Hi mercenaries,[/h3]

Today, we're delivering another update for Steam, Epic, and GoG players.
Console updates are in the pipeline but require certification, so they'll be arriving at a different time.
We remain dedicated to swiftly improving the game and tackling additional bug fixes.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[h3][b]BUGFIXES[/b][/h3]

[list][*]Fixed bug that caused Could Not Set Character Positions when loading the save if there was activation of Demolitionist [spoiler]Mech Suit[/spoiler] in Demolitionist alternative skin. Saves corrupted by that bug should load properly now
[*]Fixed Battle Goal 'Opener' shown always as 1/1
[*]Fixed bug that caused gold tile not to show hint if the enemy was killed with a trap
[*]Fixed bug in Multiplayer in reward distribution after Scenario 84
[*]Fixed bug in Multiplayer that caused a player to remain in session or having a duplicate of said player  created even after exiting
[*]Fixed UI issue that caused damage to mercenary to remain hidden until the Receive Damage button is hovered
[*]Fixed desync in Multiplayer session that sometimes appeared when buying item from Merchant
[*]Fixed softlock when the host tried to abandon quest after the client disconnected
[*]Fixed desync in Multiplayer session that appeared when the player disconnected while taking damage
[*]Fixed hint about Difficult or Hazardous terrain to be overlaid on character's info
[*]Cthulhu: [spoiler]fixed bug that made impossible confirmation of Willing Sacrifice on gamepad input[/spoiler]
[*]Saw: [spoiler]fixed bug with Triage ability not accessible after two card actions were played[/spoiler]
[/list]

[i][b]Note:[/b][/i] due to the console works, some assets required some rework. This will not affect PC nor Mac versions, but structural differences affected the size of the patch, that's why this one is quite big.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[h3][b]USEFUL INFORMATION[/b][/h3]

[list][*]Some of your issues may be coming from mods not being updated for the newest version. Launching the game without mods might fix some of theses issues.

[*][b]How to Join the Mac Open Beta:[/b]

To access the Mac Open Beta branch, simply follow these steps:

- Right-click on Gloomhaven in your Steam Library.
- Select "Properties."
- Navigate to the "BETAS" tab.
- Choose "mac_open_beta" from the drop-down list.

We invite you to create a backup save, as this version is still pretty early and rough.
You can find your save 

- Here for Windows:
C:\Users<USERNAME>\AppData\LocalLow\FlamingFowlStudios\Gloomhaven

- And here for Mac:
/Library/Application Support/FlamingFowlStudios/Gloomhaven
[b]OR [/b]
[i](depending on the version you have)[/i]
/user/Library/Application Support/unity.FlamingFowlStudios.Gloomhaven/GloomSaves/Campaign

Note that your save from the main build or V28009 should be fully compatible.[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v.1.0.7413.0 for PC
notes.content:
Hello all,

Another day, another hotfix.
This will release for Steam, Epic and GoG users today - keep in mind Epic and GoG might roll out a bit later as they function differently.
Thank you for your feedback and bug reports over the last few weeks, we have been working hard to fix many of those and hope to fix many more!

Additionally, the Mac Beta should roll out in a few days with. Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[h3][b]BUGFIXES[/b][/h3]

[list][*]Initiative bar on high enemies number now shows short versions of enemy portraits in multiplayer mode
[*]Fixed bug that caused softlock when playing with gamepad and opening Ability Cards menus during enemy or ally turns.
[*]Fixed bug that sometimes caused enemies to be stucked in one another after pushing them on long distances
[*]Fixed bug that caused DLC activation on existing save to hide information about mercs and their gold
[*]Fixed card animations in card lists sometimes not showing discarded or burned states. 
[*]Fixed players' avatars white texturing in multiplayer.
[*]Fixed map in Guildmaster movement with WASD.
[*]Click-through opened left panels now properly returns players to World Map. 
[*]Fixed bug with gamepad on selecting/deselecting cards in All mercenary cards window.
[*]Fixed bug that allowed players to go into scenario in Multiplayer Mode without battle goal for a mercenary.
[*]Fixed bug in second tutorial that caused hint to stay up until the end of the tutorial.
[*]Angry Face: fixed bug that caused softlock when playing with gamepad and applying third Doom card on an enemy with two active Doom effects.
[*]Two Minis: fixed bug that made [spoiler]"Jaws Of Death" [/spoiler]top ability not usable when playing with gamepad.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[h3][b]USEFUL INFORMATION[/b][/h3]

[list][*]Some of your issues may be coming from mods not being updated for the newest version. Launching the game without mods might fix some of theses issues.

[*]For anyone having trouble playing on the last updates or wanting to return to the latest pre-Saber version e.g. the same version as the latest Mac release, it is available on Steam, and here is how to opt in:

- To opt into the last pre-update version, v.28009, right-click on the game in Steam -> Properties -> BETAS and select the "v.28009" from the drop-down list.

- [i][b]Important information:[/b][/i] switching to the open beta or this v.28009 version might corrupt the save files if you have launched the newer version before doing it.

You simply have to do a backup of the initial save file to protect your save - Save files are located in C:\Users<USERNAME>\AppData\LocalLow\FlamingFowlStudios\Gloomhaven

If you are moving from the regular version of the game to Open Beta, simply create a copy of your GloomSaves folder and rename it to GloomSavesV28009.
Individual saves can also be copied between the Guildmaster folders if you prefer.
[/list]

notes.title: Mac Open Beta Announcement
notes.content:
[h3]Hello mercenaries,[/h3]

We have an important update for all the Mac users out there: the launch of an Open Beta branch dedicated to Mac players, which should open in about 2 weeks. We will of course keep you informed as soon as the exact date is determined.
We appreciate your patience and understanding as we've worked to make this happen. 

[b]Here's everything you need to know:[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/80c60e3e23bcd43b5aaef5841f7a8c3a5d0defef.png[/img]

[h2]What's included in the Mac Open Beta?[/h2]

In this initial phase, the Mac Open Beta branch will enable crossplay with other Steam users only. 
You'll be joining players on Steam who are on the latest version of the update.
This means you'll have access to all the content and improvements introduced in the latest main update, along with the four subsequent hotfixes.

For PC players that want to be able to cross-play with Mac on the latest updated version, you will also need to opt in to this Mac Open Beta branch.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/80c60e3e23bcd43b5aaef5841f7a8c3a5d0defef.png[/img]

[h2]Why an Open Beta?[/h2]

We aim to minimize further waiting times for Mac players and we care to show you that we have heard you and learned from our previous experiences. 
Please note that this branch is still a work in progress and will, consequently, need a good amount of bug fixing and polishing.

Your feedback during this Open Beta will be invaluable in helping us refine the game further. 
We encourage you to share your thoughts on the dedicated Discord channel and report any issues you encounter when the Beta goes live.
You can join the Discord here: [url=discord.gg/gloomhaven]discord.gg/gloomhaven[/url]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/80c60e3e23bcd43b5aaef5841f7a8c3a5d0defef.png[/img]

[h2]Looking for a stable build?[/h2]

If you'd like a more stable version while waiting for the Mac version to reach full stability, you can always switch back to the v.28009 build, which is available on Steam.
To opt into the last pre-update version, v.28009, right-click on the game in Steam -> Properties -> BETAS and select the "v.28009" from the drop-down list.

- Important information: switching to the open beta or this v.28009 version might corrupt the save files if you have launched the newer version before doing it.

You simply have to do a backup of the initial save file to protect your save - Save files are located in C:\Users<USERNAME>\AppData\LocalLow\FlamingFowlStudios\Gloomhaven

If you are moving from the regular version of the game to Open Beta, simply create a copy of your GloomSaves folder and rename it to GloomSavesV28009.
Individual saves can also be copied between the Guildmaster folders if you prefer.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/80c60e3e23bcd43b5aaef5841f7a8c3a5d0defef.png[/img]

Thank you for being a part of the Gloomhaven community. 
We're working hard and are committed to providing you with the best possible gaming experience across all platforms, and we appreciate your support and understanding.

notes.title: Hotfix v.1.0.7149.0 for PC
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've been closely monitoring your feedback and concerns following the latest update. 

Today, we're rolling out our first hotfix to address some of these reported bugs. 
Please know we're not stopping here as we are already into the development of the next hotfix and updates.
Some issues require a bit more time to be identified and fixed, hence this hotfix releasing first. Thank you for your help identifying and reporting these issues!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[b][h3]BUGFIXES[/h3][/b]
[list][*]Fixed Enchantress input
[*]Fixed UI issue with grey card duplicate on new cards in Level Up screen
[*]Hatchet: fixed issue with Hatchet's Favorite causing desyncs in Multiplayer if EGS build was in session
[*]Two Minis: fixed issue with Concentrated Rage ability causing desyncs in Multiplayer if EGS build was in session
[*]Removed sounds from card lists in Mastered Abilities and in battle (Mouse/Keyboard controls)
[*]Build version is now shown[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[b][h3]ADDITIONAL INFORMATION[/h3][/b]
[list][*]Some of your issues may be coming from mods not being updated for the newest version. Launching the game without mods might fix some of theses issues.

[*]Some of you let us know that you didn't like the "skip" and "undo" button being swapped for keyboard and mouse users.
We will be adding an option in the next update to switch these controls on your will.

- Some context: This change was made to ensure a strong UX on consoles. It is intuitive to have the Cancel option on Circle (B) and the Skip option on Square (X) as that is the norm in the industry. This change was implemented onto PC to ensure a cohesive experience and similar button placement for all platforms.

[*]We're actively addressing a list of known issues for our upcoming updates, and your input is incredibly valuable to us. 
If you encounter any bugs, please consider sharing your reports and information with us by submitting a ticket here: [url=https://asmodee.helpshift.com/hc/en/75-gloomhaven/contact-us/]https://asmodee.helpshift.com/hc/en/75-gloomhaven/contact-us/[/url]
Your help will aid us in resolving these issues as fast and efficiently as possible.

- On another note, some of you have mentioned that the support form didn't work properly.
We checked on our side and it is usually linked to either a captcha or field not being filled out, or a report being heavier than 25Mo. If you have video that doesn't fit the first submitting form, you simply need to open a ticket with our support team without it, and then you will be able to share it with them.

[*]While we're working on new bug fixes and upcoming updates, we saw several of you asked of the opportunity to play on the last pre-update version of the game - we have uploaded it on Steam, and here is how to opt in:

- To opt into the last pre-update version, v.28009, right-click on the game in Steam -> Properties -> BETAS and select the "v.28009" from the drop-down list.

- [i][b]Important information:[/b][/i] switching to the open beta or this v.28009 version might corrupt the save files if you have launched the newer version before doing it.

You simply have to do a backup of the initial save file to protect your save - Save files are located in C:\Users<USERNAME>\AppData\LocalLow\FlamingFowlStudios\Gloomhaven

If you are moving from the regular version of the game to Open Beta, simply create a copy of your GloomSaves folder and rename it to GloomSavesV28009.
Individual saves can also be copied between the Guildmaster folders if you prefer.
[/list]

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE & NEW FEATURES
notes.content:
[h3]Our warmest welcome, fellow mercenaries![/h3]

We are gathered here today to celebrate the new PC update, containing new features, many bug fixes and quality of life improvements.
You can find more details below.

[i][h3]Also... the four new Jaws of the Lion mercenary skins are available on PC for free, right now, here:[/h3][/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2584170/Gloomhaven__Jaws_of_the_Lion_Alternative_Skins/


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]With the consoles release, this patch adds crossplay functionality for all players. To enable it, find the Crossplay option in Options -> General and turn it ON.
[*]Voice chat is added to the game. It can be activated when the session is hosted.
[*]Updated game engine version as the old one could cause random crashes in Mercenary panel and during scenario.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]
[h1]UI improvements & quality of life[/h1]
[list]
[*]The gamepad option has been updated to fit with the console one.
[*]Updated visuals in Scenario HUD for initiative panel and card deck portraits.
[*]Inactive action buttons are now hidden instead of going in unclickable states.
[*]Added new identifications of control in Multiplayer mode.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]
[h1]Scenario Fixes[/h1]
[h3]Guildmaster[/h3]
[list]
[*]Déjà vu: Fixed unstable crash when starting mission.
[*]Unlikely Alliance: fixed bug when sometimes mission didn’t finish after 10th round.
[*]Night of the Living Sewage: fixed bug when sometimes Deep Terror wasn’t visible to players after spawn.
[*]The Rumbling Deep: fixed bug when lava tile wasn’t properly placed on the battlefield.
[*]Face your Demons: fixed bug when mission didn’t fail after Summoner is exhausted.[/list]
[h3]Campaign[/h3]
[list]
[*]Ancient Cistern: Fixed bug when sometimes there was no ability to cleanse the pump.
[*]Vault Of Secrets: Fixed bug when Defeat screen appeared without failing any objectives during summoned creatures’ turn.
[*]Infernal Throne: Fixed error “An error occurred within one of the Rule Libraries”.
[*]Harrower Hive: Fixed error that made impossible the discard of cards at the beginning of the scenario. 
[*]Burning Mountain: fixed error in scenario that caused game to crash. 
[*]Windswept Highlands: fixed rare softlock when Beast Tyrant was present in the scenario 
[*]Scorched Summit: fixed softlock when mercenary exhausted on chest tile. 
[*]Armory Heist: fixed Rikharn portrait in character info. 
[*]Payment Due: fixed softlock when one merc picked up the chest and other one went through a trap in the same round. 
[*]Plagued Crypt: fixed Spirit of Xorn portrait in character info. [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[h1]General Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue when sometimes you couldn’t enter the save after activating Solo Scenarios DLC. 
[*]Fixed issue on gamepad control when cinematic sound continued to play if was skipped too fast. 
[*]Fixed bug which could cause multiple action abilities (like Scoundrel’s “Quick Hands”) to be used infinite amount of times. 
[*]Fixed game sometimes being locked when re-entering the Merchant in Guildmaster when there is a mercenary in the squad ready to level up . 
[*]Fixed wrong implementation of Perks after going there from the Enchantment screen. 
[*]Fixed bug which caused inability to enhance card after selling enhance from fully enchanted card. 
[*]Fixed ‘Comparing player stats…’ in multiplayer sessions at scenario starts. 
[*]Fixed item binding troubles in Guildmaster. 
[*]Fixed game crash during mercenary selection in Guildmaster Multiplayer session when two players chose same merc. 
[*]Fixed softlock after fast choosing Further ability cards after merc level up in Guildmaster. 
[*]Fixed an issue in Multiplayer that sometimes it was possible for client to join the session during Damage taking phase which caused session to drop. 
[*]Fixed issues with active abilities not giving right amount of experience when conditions are met. 
[*]Fixed problem that caused sometimes scenario icon ‘drop under’ the map. 
[*]Fixed issues with doors not open correctly in scenarios with pressure plates. 
[*]Fixed issues with correct difficulty increase in Guildmaster Job scenarios when playing with 4 mercenaries. 
[*]Fixed UI bugs encountered in lists in Merchant, Enchantress, Temple. 
[*]Fixed issue when loading the save moved summons 1 hex from the position they were.[/list]
[h3]Abilities Fix[/h3]
[b]Brute[/b]
[list]
[*]Trample – fixed softlock which was possible when Brute finished movement during Trample on a trap that causes Immobilized.[/list][b]Cragheart[/b]
[list]
[*]Rocky End – ability sometimes could cause unloaded textures to appear.
[*]Clear the Way – fixed ability logic that caused sometimes obstacle to change visual appearance.[/list][b]Red Guard[/b]
[list]
[*]Strangling Chain – attack ability caused 1 damage instead of 2 when Fire was infused.[/list][b]Spellweaver[/b]
[list]
[*]Chromatic Explosion – fixed error in bottom action which showed +2 Move for Element Infusion 
[*]Impaling Eruption –fixed bug which caused multiplayer session to crash when player was using gamepad and pressed too fast ‘Confirm Targets’.[/list][b]Angry face[/b]
[list]
[*][spoiler]Concentrated Rage – fixed bug which blocked the ability to forgo card actions if Bear was Stunned.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Borrowed Essence – fixed bug in Multiplayer which caused sometimes UI for damage redistribution not to be visible.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Tribal Sigil – fixed bug which caused multiplayer session to crash if ally near Spirit Banner attacked the target with Retaliate.[/spoiler][/list][b]Sun[/b]
[list]
[*][spoiler]Divine Intervention – fixed issues with ability in Multiplayer mode.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Unwavering Mandate - fixed issues with ability in Multiplayer mode.[/spoiler][/list][b]Three Spears[/b]
[list]
[*][spoiler]Restock – fix in Multiplayer incorrectly restored items.[/spoiler][/list][b]Triforce[/b]
[list]
[*][spoiler]Doppelganger – fixed sometimes incorrect target hex positioning when casting ability from Doppelganger position. [/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Chain Lightning – fixed targeting with Air element infused.[/spoiler][/list]
[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*]Mana Potion – now confirmation of usage is needed after elements selection.
[*]Boots of Speed – clarified UI when several items were used in one scenario. 
[*]Eagle Eye Goggles – fixed bug which caused several AoE ranged attacks to not grant straight roll of modifier when one of the targets was in melee with character.[/list]

notes.title: Gloomhaven is coming to consoles September 18
notes.content:
[h2]CONSOLE WHEN?![/h2]

For 4 years now, players on PC have been enjoying the Gloomhaven experience.

Forming your band of mercenaries and coming up with smart strategies only to friendly-fire yourselves to death. It’s meeting the infamous Oozes... and it’s sacrificing innocents for not-so-good and very hypothetical loot. 
It’s well-oiled turn-based tactical gameplay and exploring over 250 grim dungeons. 
It’s also dying a lot, but learning from your mistakes and getting better each time. At least, we hope so for your sake.

But what if you’re a console gamer? [i]Well…[/i]

We’re happy to announce that [b]Gloomhaven is coming[/b] to Nintendo, Sony and Microsoft [b]consoles[/b] (PS4/PS5 Xbox One/Series X & S/Nintendo Switch) 
[h3][b]September 18, 2023[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/3db0e95c25323e38bd087ad9b8aeca1d602173f7.jpg[/img]

It’s being developed by our partners at Saber Interactive, and we’re extremely proud to be able to bring this to the players in cooperation with Nintendo, Sony, Microsoft and Valve who helped us plug everything together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[h2]GLOOMHAVEN CONSOLE - NEW TRAILER[/h2]

[previewyoutube=kzOqwYNAWl4;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/80c60e3e23bcd43b5aaef5841f7a8c3a5d0defef.png[/img]

[h2]PRE-ORDER INFORMATION[/h2]

[h3]➡ Where to pre-order?[/h3]

[b]PRE-ORDER ON[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/gloomhaven-gold-edition-switch/]Nintendo Switch US[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nintendo.co.uk/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/Gloomhaven-2401522.html?s=countries]Nintendo Switch EU[/url]
[*][url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/gloomhaven-gold-edition/9p9nzpccmbv5]Xbox One & XBox Series X/S[/url]
[*][url=https://store.playstation.com/product/EP4917-PPSA08116_00-GLOOMHAVENGOLDB1/]PS4 & PS5[/url][/list]
[h3]➡ Pre-order advantages[/h3]

You will be able to choose between 2 editions: 
[list]
[*][b]The Gold Edition[/b]
[*][b]The Mercenaries Edition[/b][/list]
The [b]Gold Edition[/b] is available for €/$44.99 (standard price €/$49.99) and includes the base game, the 'Solo Scenarios' DLC, plus the 'Jaws of the Lion' DLC and four new skins for said DLC.

The [b]Mercenaries Edition[/b] is available for €/$35.99 (standard price €/$39.99) and includes the base game and the 'Solo Scenarios' DLC.  

These new skins will be available as a free DLC to PC players after the console release as well!

[h3]➡ Crossplay[/h3]

The upcoming console versions of the game will feature crossplay functionality, allowing players to join forces and enjoy the game together across different platforms. 
Whether you're on a console or PC, you'll have the opportunity to connect and embark on exciting adventures with friends, regardless of their chosen gaming platform. 
Prepare for an immersive cooperative experience!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[h2]JOIN THE GLOOMHAVEN COMMUNITY[/h2]
[b]we love Cragheart[/b]

Coooome to share with us your thoughts, screenshots, gameplay and virtually anything that you please on [url=https://twitter.com/Gloomhaven_Digi]Twitter[/url].
We also post fun content (*meeeeemes*) and share tips & tricks!

You can also join our dedicated Discord server here: discord.gg/gloomhaven to receive help and advice, meet other players and discuss any topic you want!
You will be received with friendliness, unlike in Gloomhaven's dungeons...

We are also on [url=https://www.facebook.com/GloomhavenDigital]Facebook[/url]!

[h3]Until next time, mercenaries...[/h3]

notes.title: Some news about the console port and PC version!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone![/h3]

Let me introduce myself to you all!

I'm Mike, Tech Lead at Saber, and one of the many people currently working on Gloomhaven.

I have been playing both the board game & digital version of Gloomhaven for quite a while as many others here do and it's an honor and a pleasure to be able to work on it now! 

I have been working in the industry for 11 years but this game really is something else! 

We are currently working on many elements around the game.  
Here is a snippet of what's going on :
[list]
[*]We are polishing the console versions, which will release later this year, as you already know
[*]Our team is focusing on optimization for PC as well - improvements such as less loading times, less memory usage, better performance especially on low-end specs
[*]Working on a reworked UI/UX for the gamepad too! Gloomhaven is quite a complex game so the gamepad adaptation can be a real challenge.
[*]A lot of bug fixing, the full patch notes will of course be shared with you when we release the update, but our goal is to make the game even smoother![/list] 
We're aware we haven't communicated much as Gloomhaven requires a lot of attention and work. 
It always take some time to work on someone's else code, even more when we are expanding it for cross-platform play. 

We hope to deliver everything at the same time as the console release but some things might take a bit longer. 

At any rate, everything should be live before the end of 2023! 
We're very excited to share all of this with you.

Thank you for your patience, your support and your love for the game!

Mike

notes.title: SOLO SCENARIOS: MERCENARY CHALLENGES DLC NOW AVAILABLE
notes.content:
[i]Every mercenary has a demon to face or a story to tell.
Let this be the moment you discover those tales and face these challenges.
See what they saw, do what they did, and fight what they fought. 
Alone. In the dark. Will they be able to overcome these trials?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h2] YOUR END HAS COME - OUR SECOND AND MOST DIFFICULT DLC IS NOW AVAILABLE [/h2]

Head over to Gloomhaven's "Solo Scenarios: Mercenary Challenges DLC" page to see if you have the mettle to face these overwhelmingly difficult battles. Best of luck, mercenary!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1958560/Gloomhaven__Solo_Scenarios_Mercenary_Challenges

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h2] FACE YOUR EXPECTED DOOM IN THIS NEW DLC [/h2]

Here it is, mercenaries!
Below you can find a quick summary of what you can expect to find in this DLC:
You will quickly discern that this DLC will be a considerably harder experience than you know of.
If you haven't already, you'll have to git gud.
[list]
[*]17 new amazingly brutal scenarios, each built to challenge Mercenaries from the campaign.[list][*]Every mercenary will have a specific mission they will need to complete on their own.[*]The unique mission to each mercenary will explore their specific backstory and narrative.[/list][*]17 new items, each usable by only one specific Mercenary.
[*]Items & scenarios were reworked and rebalanced by Isaac Childres himself to fit the digital version. 
[list][*]Feedback was collected over many years by Isaac, resulting in buffs, nerfs and outright changes to many items.[/list][*]New unique enemies and challenges.[/list][i]To be able to spectate or play the Solo Scenarios: Mercenary Challenges content in multiplayer co-op, every player has to own the DLC.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h2] IMPORTANT INFORMATION [/h2]

[list]
[*]You can only gain access to the DLC missions at Level 5 in the Story Campaign.
[*]When a mercenary reaches Level 5, they are able to undertake their own Solo mission.
Alternatively, you can gain access to the DLC unique rewards in the Guildmaster Mode when completing the 2nd Story mission for each mercenary.
[*]You only gain access to the items if you complete the missions, these items cannot be sold or bought by other characters. 
The mercenary has to attempt the missions on their own and if they are successful, they are awarded their specific Solo item. This item cannot be sold or bought by other characters, and any later mercenaries of the same class must also complete this mission to unlock it.
[*]You can play these missions online in a Multiplayer game, but your co-op companions will be in spectator mode, watching you hopelessly try to survive.
[*]You can also play these missions offline. Then, to import the fruit of your hard labor to any game, it will be automatic if you’re the host, and if you are not the host and join a game, the host has the option to import any Gold, XP and Item you gained in the Solo Scenarios.[/list]
[i]Note - DLC enabled save games cannot be reverted to non-DLC games.[/i] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h2] FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS [/h2]

[h3][b]Which mercenaries have their own solo scenario in this new DLC?[/b][/h3]
Each of the 17 mercenaries of the base game have access to their own tailored scenario.
This does not apply to the Jaws of the Lion DLC mercenaries.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]How long is the DLC going to be at launch? [/b][/h3]
You can expect about 20+ hours to finish the 17 new missions.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]How much will the DLC cost?[/b][/h3]
The Solo Scenarios: Mercenary Challenges DLC for Gloomhaven will cost 4.99$ / 4.99€. Get 10% off this new DLC until September 29.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]Can we expect further updates / DLCs after that?[/b] [/h3]
Although we cannot share anything at this point, we will keep supporting the game after the release of the Solo Scenarios: Mercenary Challenges DLC.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]How many languages will be supported on this DLC? [/b][/h3]
All the languages of the base game will be supported: English, German, French and Spanish.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]On which platforms will this DLC be released? [/b][/h3]
The DLC will be available on Steam and GoG for Windows & MacOS. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h2]JOIN THE GLOOMHAVEN COMMUNITY[/h2]
we rock (lol, pun intended)

This week, we celebrate 3 years since the Early Access launch of Gloomhaven.
We are incredibly thankful for all the support you have shown over the course of this unique adventure, and cannot wait to share even more moments with you.

As you venture through the lands of Gloomhaven, share with us your thoughts, screenshots, gameplay and virtually anything that you please on [url=https://twitter.com/Gloomhaven_Digi]Twitter[/url].
We also post fun content (*meeeeemes*) and share tips & tricks!

You can also join our dedicated Discord server here: discord.gg/gloomhaven to receive help and advice, meet other players and discuss any topic you want!
You will be received with tremendous friendliness and warmth!

notes.title: SOLO SCENARIOS: MERCENARY CHALLENGES DLC RELEASES SEPTEMBER 22
notes.content:
[i]Black Barrow. Haunting my dreams, shadowing my days. 
Deep within, I fear what lies below -  what we faced. Yet, here I am again, alone. 
I'm the Brute, I kill what people fear. 
I’ll kill my fear too.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h2] FACE YOUR EXPECTED DOOM IN THIS NEW DLC [/h2]

Lo and behold, mercenaries!
Here is a quick summary of what you can expect from this DLC:
A considerably harder experience than the base game. 
You’ll definitely have to git gud this time.
[list]
[*]17 new delightfully brutal scenarios, each tailored to a specific base game Mercenary.
[*]17 new items, usable only by one specific Mercenary.
[*]Items & scenarios reworked and rebalanced by Isaac Childres himself to better fit the digital version. 
[*]New unique enemies and challenges.[/list]
You can already wishlist the Solo Scenarios: Mercenary Challenges DLC today on Steam, right below!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1958560/Gloomhaven__Solo_Scenarios_Mercenary_Challenges

[i]To be able to spectate or play the Solo Scenarios: Mercenary Challenges content in multiplayer co-op, every player has to own the DLC.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h2] IMPORTANT INFORMATION [/h2]

[list]
[*]You can only gain access to the DLC missions at Level 5 in the Story Campaign.
[*]When a mercenary reaches Level 5, they are able to undertake their own Solo mission.
Alternatively, you can gain access to the DLC unique rewards in the Guildmaster Mode when completing the 2nd Story mission for each mercenary.
[*]You only gain access to the items if you complete the missions, these items cannot be sold or bought by other characters. 
The mercenary has to attempt the missions on their own and if they are successful, they are awarded their specific Solo item. This item cannot be sold or bought by other characters, and any later mercenaries of the same class must also complete this mission to unlock it.
[*]You can play these missions online in a Multiplayer game, but your co-op companions will be in spectator mode, watching you hopelessly try to survive.
[*]You can also play these missions offline. Then, to import the fruit of your hard labor to any game, it will be automatic if you’re the host, and if you are not the host and join a game, the host has the option to import any Gold, XP and Item you gained in the Solo Scenarios.[/list]
[i]Note - DLC enabled save games cannot be reverted to non-DLC games.[/i] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h2] FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS [/h2]

[h3][b]Which mercenaries have their own solo scenario in this new DLC?[/b][/h3]
Each of the 17 mercenaries of the base game have access to their own tailored scenario.
This does not apply to the Jaws of the Lion DLC mercenaries.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]How long is the DLC going to be at launch? [/b][/h3]
You can expect about 20+ hours to finish the 17 new missions.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]How much will the DLC cost?[/b][/h3]
The Solo Scenarios: Mercenary Challenges DLC for Gloomhaven will cost 4.99$ / 4.99€.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]Can we expect further updates / DLCs after that?[/b] [/h3]
Although we cannot share anything at this point, we will keep supporting the game after the release of the Solo Scenarios: Mercenary Challenges DLC.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]How many languages will be supported on this DLC? [/b][/h3]
All the languages of the base game will be supported: English, German, French and Spanish.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]On which platforms will this DLC be released? [/b][/h3]
The DLC will be available on Steam and GoG for Windows & MacOS. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h2]JOIN THE GLOOMHAVEN COMMUNITY[/h2]
we rock (lol, pun intended)

This week, we celebrate 3 years since the Early Access launch of Gloomhaven.
We are incredibly thankful for all the support you have shown over the course of this unique adventure, and cannot wait to share even more moments with you.
[h3]Happy Early Access Anniversary, Gloomhavenologists![/h3]

As you venture through the lands of Gloomhaven, share with us your thoughts, screenshots, gameplay and virtually anything that you please on [url=https://twitter.com/Gloomhaven_Digi]Twitter[/url].
We also post fun content (*meeeeemes*) and share tips & tricks!

You can also join our dedicated Discord server here: discord.gg/gloomhaven to receive help and advice, meet other players and discuss any topic you want!
You will be received with tremendous friendliness and warmth!

- Its possible to click the Short Rest button immediately after performing a Short rest which can result in an error, testing a fix and aiming to patch over the weekend.

notes.title: JAWS OF THE LION - NEW DLC AVAILABLE NOW
notes.content:
[i]You and your group are sitting down for some cold brew in the Sleeping Lion after a hard day's mercenary work. Protecting that merchant was too troublesome... Suddenly a peculiar Orchid covered in an innumerable amount of crystals approaches and sits down at the table.

Looking from under her shadowed hood, she begins speaking.
"So you're the the mercenary group I've heard about?"
She looks around the table.
"Not that it says much coming from the people I heard it from. But I'd like to know what kind of feats you can muster."
She eyes each of you intently, measuring your value to her.
"Prove your true worth." She snaps "Accept the challenge that is coming and uncover all that lies beneath the veil..."

A chill runs down your spine at her final words, but before you can consider responding to the ludicrous comments of this crazed Orchid, she disappears in an instant. Your group stares quietly at one another, wondering what kind of wild and harrowing adventure awaits you all...[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/f7a16e8f92fa6dd9ce66e66067a7f6d023892882.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[h1]JAWS OF THE LION RELEASED[/h1]

[h3]Adventurers, will you please gather round on this glorious day? Greetings![/h3]

[previewyoutube=kv4-UH8eAW4;full][/previewyoutube]

A sinister cabal started abducting the less fortunate of the city... and it somehow falls to you to get to the bottom of it. Thankfully, in Gloomhaven, salvation has a price...

Jaws of the Lion is finally out! Here is what you will find in this brand new DLC:
[list]
[*]4 news mercenaries: the stalwart Red Guard, the fearsome Hatchet, the explosive Demolitionist and the mysterious Voidwarden are waiting for you
[*]25 new scenarios giving you access to more than 30 hours of exclusive content
[*]10 new monster types and bosses
[*]22 new city events that will put your moral compass to the test
[*]10 items that will provide new ways to defeat your foes
[*]24 Battle Goals to let down your group over whole new reasons
[*]A fully voiced campaign by Alec Newman
[*]Partial Demolitionist rework and overall perks improvements for the digital version
[/list]
You will be able to access the DLC through Gloomhaven’s story campaign, unlocking Jaws of the Lion’s missions after the second campaign scenario. 
Alternatively, you will be able to play with the new mercenaries and items in the Guildmaster and Story campaigns. Jaws of the Lion can be played solo or in coop mode for up to four players. 
To access The Jaws of the Lion content in multiplayer Coop every player has to own the DLC.

[b]You can buy it right now on Steam: [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1809490/Gloomhaven__Jaws_of_the_Lion/


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[h2]Don't have Gloomhaven yet?[/h2]

Get it right now for 25% off (offer available until May 23), and enjoy the entire board game campaign as well as the guildmaster one, exclusive to the digital verson of Gloomhaven!
Enjoy 17 unique characters, each coming with their own skills, ttousands of abilities, perks, items and enhancements and dark and challenging environments filled with dangerous enemies of all sorts.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/780290/Gloomhaven/


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[h2]RECRUIT FOUR NEW FEARSOME MERCENARIES[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/fea3f06821aff95ecc8bedbe74164409d8d63571.jpg[/img]

[h3]VOIDWARDEN[/h3]
After surviving an encounter with the void as a child, they are now able to harness its mysterious magic to protect others from a similar fate. Minds are open books for the Voidwarden, and they manipulate the thoughts and actions of both allies and foes... but always at a heavy price.

[h3]DEMOLITIONIST[/h3]
Always ready to destroy any obstacle that stands in their way, the Quatryl Demolitionist is a force to be reckoned with. They can augment their body with very powerful and quite unstable contraptions to devastate enemies on the battlefield. You might want to move aside.

[h3]HATCHET[/h3]
The Inox Hatchet is a sinister marksman. He has a strong inclination for axe-throwing, and knows how to hold a grudge. Oh! And his enemies are just as good as dead. They simply might not know it yet.

[h3]RED GUARD[/h3]
With their distinctive red armor, shield and chained sickle, the Valrath Red Guard manipulates the battlefield. They are able to both protect their allies and keep their enemies at bay, handling multiple opponents at once. None shall escape the Red Guard’s grasp…


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[h2] FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS [/h2]


[h3][b]Is the DLC a standalone campaign? [/b][/h3]

No, you are able to integrate the content of the DLC (4 mercenaries, 10 items and 25 new scenarios) with a simple click of a button into an existing Story campaign without having to start over. Alternatively, all new Story campaigns will have all new mercenaries and scenarios available from the start, while the Guildmaster campaigns will only include the new mecenaries and items.
[b]Note:[/b] [i]DLC-enabled save games cannot be reverted to non-DLC games. 
If you play in the Guildmaster mode, once converting the save or starting a new game the 4 mercenaries will be immediately available and the items will be added to various treasure tables. [/i]

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]Why is JOTL not a standalone like the board game?[/b][/h3]

Having Jaws of the Lion as a DLC allowed us to mix and match the content of Gloomhaven and Jaws of the Lion. We needed to change some things in Jaws of the Lion for that to happen smoothly. It also allowed us to mix some of the content of the DLC with the Guildmaster mode!

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]How long is the DLC?[/b][/h3]

You can expect about 30+ hours of entirely new content.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]How many players can play together online? [/b][/h3]

You will be able to play online up to 4 players, the same as the base game. Once a saved game is converted to be DLC compatible, all players will require the DLC to be able to join.
When starting a new campaign you will have the option to activate Jaws of the Lion or play with the base game only.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]Can we expect further updates / DLCs after that?[/b][/h3]

Although we cannot share anything at this point, we will keep supporting the game after the release of Jaws of the Lion.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]How many languages are supported on Jaws of the Lion?[/b][/h3]

All the languages of the base game will be supported.
These languages are English, French, German and Spanish.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
 
[h3][b]On which platforms is Jaws of the Lion released?[/b][/h3]

The DLC will be available on Steam and GoG for Windows & MacOS. 

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]What about bugs?[/b][/h3]

Gloomhaven is a colossal game and Jaws of the Lion is adding thousands of mercenary combinations, possible abilities, items, perks, enhancements and enemies. While we have invested a massive amount of time and effort on making sure Jaws is ready and of the highest quality, you may still encounter issues here and there.

If you experience any bugs or issues that break the game or hinder you from progressing in the game, please report them on our support portal. 
The devs would really appreciate it if you attach a video or a screenshot of the issue and all of the information you have available. That will help us a lot in our investigation!

You can find the support portal here:
https://asmodee.helpshift.com/hc/en/75-gloomhaven/

You can contact us directly here:
https://asmodee.helpshift.com/hc/en/75-gloomhaven/contact-us/



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[h2]JOIN THE GLOOMHAVEN COMMUNITY[/h2]
[b]we rule[/b]

As you venture through the lands of Gloomhaven in the newest Jaws of the Lion DLC, share with us your thoughts, screenshots, gameplay and virtually anything that you please on [url=https://twitter.com/Gloomhaven_Digi]Twitter[/url].
We also post fun content (*meeeeemes*) and share tips & tricks!

You can also join our dedicated Discord server here: discord.gg/gloomhaven to receive help and advice, meet other players and discuss any topic you want!
You will be received with tremendous friendliness and warmth!

We are also on [url=https://www.facebook.com/GloomhavenDigital]Facebook[/url] and have a brand new [url=https://www.instagram.com/gloomhavendigital/]Instagram[/url] page, where we post exclusive content and updates!

[h3]See you next time, mercenaries![/h3]

notes.title: Dev Blog #2
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, fellow mercenaries![/h3]

Now is the time for you to meet the remaining two mercenaries from the upcoming Jaws of the Lion DLC: Voidwarden and Demolitionist.

[i][b]As a reminder:[/b][/i]

Each of these characters brings something new to combat within Gloomhaven Digital, including their own unique powerful ability when they reach level 5 so be prepared for spoilers about their gameplay and stop reading now if you want it to be a surprise! 

[[i]Note: some parts of this article are hidden under black lines to avoid spoilers - Hover over them if you wish to reveal the content![/i]]

The important thing to know is that these characters are available to use in your core Gloomhaven scenarios and core mercs can take part in Jaws scenarios, neither are limited to their own content, so the amount of combos has increased massively.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/24fc63ab7c7b87272da80ac898fe3fc363f7ff4f.png[/img]
[h3]Control Freak[/h3]

The Voidwarden has access to a wide range of abilities, suited to almost any occasion, as long as that occasion involves an assortment of fangs, claws and various rusty weapons pointed in your direction. She excels however at control, both via classic crowd control abilities, debuffing multiple enemies or by directly controlling ally or enemy actions. The sheer range of options for her top and bottom half abilities can be intimidating at first.

Also, due to her ability to buff her allies (often with minor drawbacks) she performs better in larger parties where there are more mercs to aid and more enemies to exterminate.
[spoiler][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/2a4de4c7ac2c7af442f74da4c3c336ddc1d2b833.png[/img]
[/spoiler]
[h3]Call the Burn Ward[/h3]
[spoiler]The Voidwarden’s Level 5 ability allows them to summon a Ward, a defensive obstacle that both poisons nearby enemies and protects the Voidwarden with a defensive disadvantage shield. As the Ward cannot be moved once placed, you’ll need to think ahead to ensure she can stay close throughout the scenario to continue to gain its effects. 
[/spoiler]
[h3]With friends like these[/h3]

When playing as the Voidwarden you need to ensure your allies actually ‘want’ the bonuses you are giving them. Unlike other support classes, the Voidwarden’s buffs often come with a  drawback and that has the possibility of really hampering your friends’ plans. Then again, maybe they shouldn’t have looted ‘your’ chest? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/f4b16235623a77f2feebfcc2f0ed3457175dd75f.png[/img]

Now who have we left until last? The Tinkerer with jet boots and massive punchy gloves and a pink bandana.. Also, why haven’t I dived straight into their abilities I hear you ask, well, if you are a Gloomhaven old salt, you might be ready to say ‘Oh that Demolitionist, it works in Jaws, but if you take them into the core Gloomhaven missions the levels aren’t set up right for their abilities.’

Well, Isaac heard you, and Isaac’s design team heard Isaac, and we heard Isaac’s design team, so for Gloomhaven Digital, the Demolitionist has had a bunch of redesigns and therefore, we’ll start with the rebalance and then move onto the play style…

Firstly a number of cards have had terminology changes, but that is across the board for Jaws, mainly ‘Objectives’ changing to ‘Obstacles with hit points’ so that a number of their abilities work in the core Gloomhaven experience.

The other more major changes are as follows:

[b]Implode Bottom[/b] - The rework here gives the ability more uses, similar to a powered up version of a couple of the Cragheart’s abilities.

[b]Rubble Top[/b] - This was the only card that used Destruction tokens which Isaac decided to remove from the Demolitionist’s gameplay, so this ability is changed to be a powerful attack.

[b]Rubble Bottom[/b] - Rebalanced after the changes to Destruction tokens and pushing the Demolitionist’s Dungeon altering abilities.

[b]Nowhere to Run Bottom[/b] - Another ability doubling down on Obstacle movement.

[spoiler][b]Mech Suit Top[/b] - You still get a mech, but instead of a simple heal (Not great if poisoned!), you get a free rest.

[b]Mech Suit Bottom[/b] - The Loot has been upgraded to a small attack plus obstacle creation.[/spoiler]

So, how does this make the Demolitionist play?
[spoiler][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/ab8414f4450928a1a68dbabc59c33a03dc6e1705.png[/img]
[/spoiler]
[h3]I can move any Mountain[/h3]

The Demolitionist now has their obstacle movement and creation ability turned up to 11. Obstacles can be utilized to funnel enemies into your allies’ path, or reroute them through traps. Whereas in the past the player had to juggle Demolition tokens, they have more options and keep access to the Demolitionists better cards. Just remember you can’t actually drop a rock on someone’s head, leave that to ol’ Craggie.

[h3]Mechwarrior[/h3]
[spoiler]The Demolitionist’s Level 5 ability gives them a decent health upgrade but more importantly refreshes ALL their discarded cards. This is now a key gameplay component, the moment to drop the mech will be extremely important although a slightly easier decision than Crystal face’s Reviving Ether.
Of course, the Demolitionist stomping about in a Mech also looks pretty cool!
[/spoiler]
[h3]Punch Out![/h3]

Aside from throwing rocks around and piloting a big robot, the Demolitionist is a melee damage dealer at heart, loving to get in close, smashing an enemy in the face and them pushing them away or backing off. They are best used protecting the squishier members of the team from danger.

The Demolitionist also have a pretty unique set of Perks, allowing them to remove a lot of Perks from their deck to get to their juicier hits more often, making every punch hit that little bit harder.

[h2]Perks[/h2]

How convenient… I talk about Perks, and then look, a Perks section… Many fans of Jaws also have remarked in the past that a couple of the mercs are missing classic Gloomhaven Perks and this affects them badly in the full Gloomhaven campaign.

Well, again Isaac has been thinking of you, so there are some minor Perk tweaks as well in Jaws Digital:

The Demolitionist & Voidwarden get an ‘Ignore scenario effects’ perk and the Red Guard gets a perk that unlocks ‘Ignore Negative Item Effects’ to have access to the swanky armor sets. 

There are a few other minor tweaks to go along with these, but you’ll be able to check them out on the Perks screen in game.

The Hatchet declared themselves ‘perfect’ and sat in the corner sharpening their axes, so it was decided to leave them be. 

[h1]In Conclusion[/h1]

That’s it for now, why not post a thought on which mercs you want to try out first, or come to our [url=discord.gg/gloomhaven]Discord server[/url] and discuss strategies or find other players to take Jaws on with?

You can always follow updates, share content and memes with us on our [url=https://twitter.com/Gloomhaven_Digi]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/GloomhavenDigital]Facebook page[/url], and check our awesome visual content on our [url=https://www.instagram.com/gloomhavendigital/]brand new Instagram[/url]!

[h3]See you on May 17 for the Jaws of the Lion release, adventurers![/h3]

notes.title: v.27088 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added basic controller support
[*] Tinkerer Traps now have their own unique skins & improvements to the biome themed traps in different scenarios.
[*] Added a tooltip to better explain Cragheart's [spoiler] Stone Pummel active, and when to destroy an obstacle to add bonus to attacks [/spoiler] this ability will also [spoiler] autoselect an adjacent obstacle to be destroyed if there is only one available obstacle to choose from [/spoiler]

[*] Fixed the hitbox on traps being difficult to mouse over and bring up its info
[*] Fixed not being able to swap cards in/out of the deck immediately after leveling up (no longer have to close and open the panel again)
[*] Fixed props / obstacles changing how they look visually after reloading a save

[*] Fixed a Multiplayer issue in Scenario 52 (and similar) [spoiler] The special rule 'Forgo' action could cause desyncs [/spoiler]

[*] Fixed an issue with changing keybindings where they would not save until after restarting, they now will.

[*] Fixed a campaign logic issue where players could incorrectly draw Road event 75 after completing Scenario 34 [spoiler] (After they killed the Elder Drake) [/spoiler]

[*] Fixed an issue with pushing an enemy that has retaliate onto a trap and them incorrectly retaliating when they should be dead
[*] Fixed multiple Multiplayer issues around joining a session while another merc is retiring
[*] Fixed an issue affecting Mac users with an underscore in their username
[*] Fixed multiple issues around certain types of innate ability that monsters and Summons can have e.g [spoiler] Cultist's on-death [/spoiler]
[*] Added a fix for not being able to Undo certain abilities if those abilities are being performed after a move (in the same action)
[*] Fixed the Battle Goal 'Pacifist' incorrectly incrementing after the first Round of a scenario
[*] Fixed a Multiplayer issue with certain special scenario rules [spoiler] Ones that require Mercs to 'Forgo' an action [/spoiler] where deselecting could desync players
[*] Fixed how the icon displays for a particular effect granted by a certain prosperity 3 item [spoiler] Immovable / Heavy Greaves [/spoiler]
[*] Fixed an issue where ally summons & enemies would not negotiate terrain hexes correctly with their move actions in some situations
[*] Fixed an issue with enemies whose spawn is triggered in the middle of a round (but not from opening doors) not acting at correct initiatives
[*] Fixed an issue with the item [spoiler] Cloak of Phasing [/spoiler] interacting incorrectly with two-hex obstacles
[*] Fixed an issue where the confirm button could disappear if players used the 'view card UI' by pressing keys 1-4 whilst choosing a card to burn on a Short or Long rest
[*] Fixed an issue with the main menu not working after encountering a certain error in gameplay
[*] Fixed a softlock that could occur if using 'Restart round' during Spellweaver's [spoiler] Living Torch Summon's On-death attack [/spoiler]
[*] Fixed an error that could occur if monster is killed by being forced onto a terrain hex in certain situations

[*] Fixed some instances of the "!" notification incorrectly being on Merc's equipment button when they did not have any new items
[*] Fixed some issues around combos when using the ring items like [spoiler] Ring of Haste [/spoiler] & Saw's ability [spoiler] Medical Packs [/spoiler]
[/list]

notes.title: JAWS OF THE LION RELEASES MAY 17
notes.content:
[i]Soaked by the pouring rain, chilled by the cold and without any contract, four suspicious mercenaries are waiting. Soon, it will be their turn. Soon...[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h2]GET READY TO PUT YOUR HEAD IN THE LION'S JAWS[/h2]


Jaws of the Lion takes you through the undercity of Gloomhaven to investigate a series of disappearances. There, you will uncover a sinister threat and offer your kind (and self-interested) assistance. 
In addition to this new questline, the DLC brings a generous amount of content for you to add to your existing campaign. This includes new monsters, bosses, items, city events and something else I can't quite remember...
Ah yes, of course, the new mercenaries!
The Valrath Red Guard, the Inox Hatchet, the Human Voidwarden and the Quatryl Demolitionist will join your party to enrich your Gloomhaven experience.

[h3]Pre-order today to enjoy a 15% discount! [/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1809490/Gloomhaven__Jaws_of_the_Lion/

[i]To access The Jaws of the Lion content in multiplayer co-op every player has to own the DLC.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h2] FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS [/h2]


[h3][b]Is the DLC going to be a standalone campaign? [/b][/h3]

No, you are able to integrate the content of the DLC (4 mercenaries, 10 items and 25 new scenarios) with a simple click of a button into an existing Story campaign without having to start over. Alternatively, all new Story campaigns will have all new mercenaries available from the start and the new scenario content available after core mission 2. 
Note - DLC enabled save games cannot be reverted to non-DLC games. 
If you play in the Guildmaster mode, once converting the save or starting a new game the 4 mercenaries will be immediately available and the items will be added to various treasure tables. 

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]How long is the game going to be at launch?[/b][/h3]

You can expect about 30+ hours to finish the main campaign.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]How many players can play together online? [/b][/h3]

You will be able to play online up to 4 players, the same as the base game. Once a saved game is converted to be DLC compatible, all players will require the DLC to be able to join.
When starting a new campaign you will have the option to activate Jaws of the Lion or play with the base game only.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]Can we expect further updates / DLCs after that?[/b][/h3]

Although we cannot share anything at this point, we will keep supporting the game after the release of Jaws of the Lion.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]How many languages will be supported on Jaws of the Lion?[/b][/h3]

All the languages of the base game will be supported.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
 
[h3][b]On which platforms will Jaws of the Lion be released?[/b][/h3]

The DLC will be available on Steam and GoG for Windows & MacOS.

notes.title: JAWS OF THE LION - COMING SOON
notes.content:
[i]“So what, you’re a party now? A Quatryl, an Inox, a Valrath and a… whatever this one may be. Going to investigate? Don’t trouble yourselves. It is the work of vermlings I tell y’all. Ain’t nothing worse than these. Always eyeing. Always plotting. Caught one chuckling in a corner the other day. Was alone that one. Didn’t laugh for very long. I’ll tell y’all what. You prove they did it. You end them. You bring back the people, and I’ll make sure it’s worth your time.” [/i]

Lo and behold, fellow guildmasters!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h1] DISCOVER THE JAWS OF THE LION DLC TRAILER [/h1]

[previewyoutube=Xyc7r23grA4;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h1] Work is back on the menu: we’re releasing Jaws of the Lion! [/h1]

A new sinister threat is looming over Gloomhaven. A series of disappearances have plagued the city and it falls upon you, brave mercenaries, to cast a light on these shadowy events.

As we roar in anticipation, here is what you can expect from this DLC:

[list][*][b]25 new scenarios for 30+ hours of gameplay[/b], leading you to the undercity of Gloomhaven.
[*][b]Four new playable mercenaries[/b] that can also be used in the original Gloomhaven campaign:  
 [list]
[*] [b]Valrath Red Guard[/b] (tank, crowd control), an outcast from Jhinda, wielding their own kind of weapon, a chained sickle. None shall escape the Red Guard’s grasp…
[*]  [b]Inox Hatchet[/b] (ranged damage), a sinister marksman, hunter of beasts and men alike. Hatchet’s quarries are already dead, they simply don’t know it yet. 
[*] [b]Human Voidwarden[/b] (support, mind-control), who survived an encounter with the void as a child and is now able to wield its mysterious powers. Minds are open books, reality can be bent… But always at a price for the Voidwarden.
[*] [b]Quatryl Demolitionist[/b] (melee damage, obstacle manipulation), ready to destroy anything that stands in their way towards, well… Destruction. You might want to move aside. [/list]
[*][b]10 new monster types and bosses[/b]
[*][b]22 new city events[/b] full of tough moral choices
[*][b]10 items[/b] brought to the market through chests and scenarios
[*][b]24 Battle Goals[/b] to let down your group over whole new reasons[/list]
You will be able to access the DLC through Gloomhaven’s story campaign, unlocking Jaws of the Lion’s missions after the second campaign scenario. Alternatively, you will be able to play with the new mercenaries and items in the Guildmaster and Story campaigns. 

Jaws of the Lion can be played solo or in Coop mode for up to four players.
 
[h3]You can already wishlist the Jaws of the Lion DLC today on Steam.    [/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1809490/Gloomhaven__Jaws_of_the_Lion/

[i]To access The Jaws of the Lion content in multiplayer Coop every player has to own the DLC.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h1] Frequently asked questions [/h1]

[b]Is the DLC going to be a standalone campaign? [/b]
No, you are able to integrate the content of the DLC (4 mercenaries, 10 items and 25 new scenarios) with a simple click of a button into an existing Story campaign without having to start over. Alternatively, all new Story campaigns will have all new mercenaries available from the start and the new scenario content available after core mission 2. 

Note - DLC enabled save games cannot be reverted to non-DLC games. 

If you play in the Guildmaster mode, once converting the save or starting a new game the 4 mercenaries will be immediately available and the items will be added to various treasure tables. 

[b]How long is the game going to be at launch?[/b]
You can expect about 30+ hours to finish the main campaign.

[b]How many players can play together online? [/b]
You will be able to play online up to 4 players, the same as the base game. Once a saved game is converted to be DLC compatible, all players will require the DLC to be able to join.
When starting a new campaign you will have the option to activate Jaws of the Lion or play with the base game only.

[b]Can we expect further updates / DLCs after that?[/b]
Although we cannot share anything at this point, we will keep supporting the game after the release of Jaws of the Lion.

[b]How many languages will be supported on Jaws of the Lion?[/b]
All the languages of the base game will be supported.
 
[b]On which platforms will Jaws of the Lion be released?[/b]
The DLC will be available on Steam and GoG for Windows & MacOS.

notes.title: Quality of Life Update & Steam Achievements
notes.content:
[i]Standing in front of an ominous dungeon, Spellweaver did not feel as confident now as she did back at the tavern. Over there, she would gloat about how she earned all of these [b]achievements[/b]. But other mercenaries challenged her, and she had to show them all... as bragging only gets you so far.

And let me tell you, her companions did not make things any easier.
Scoundrel spent quite a while staring obsessively at a nearby chest, visibly trapped, and muttering “[b]Mine…All Mine[/b]”.
Brute, for his part, repeatedly yelled “I’ll kill them all!" and "[b]Get over Here![/b]” at an immobile skeleton, amidst a sea of profanities.

Suddenly, she caught movement in the shadows of the dungeon. Hungry things lurking, waiting, observing. A shiver ran down her spine, but the job had to be done. With a grim grin, she starting preparing a chromatic explosion...
[b]A normal day in Gloomhaven[/b].[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h3]Our warmest welcome, fellow mercenaries![/h3]

We are gathered here today to celebrate the new update, containing a lot of new content, many bug fixes and the awaited [b]Steam achievements[/b].
You can find more details below.

[h1] QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

We are adding new optional rules coming from Gloomhaven, Jaws of the Lion and Frosthaven alongside the update of several existing features. These changes and additions should let you customize your experience to a far greater extent!

[*]Permanent Enhancements option

[h3]UPDATES[/h3]

Updated - Enabled restart round in Multiplayer for the host

notes.title: MacOS Release & Development Update
notes.content:
[h1]MACOS RELEASE DAY HAS COME UPON US[/h1]

[b]Good day, glorious adventurers![/b]

Today is generous with us, as Gloomhaven is finally available on macOS.
[i][b]*YAY*[/b][/i]

We worked hard to release a macOS version that would be fully stable and of a quality level we deemed appropriate for Gloomhaven players.
As of right now, we are happy to announce that we have met the standards we set for the macOS version to be released, hence this brilliant update. 
We are very excited to be giving macOS players the opportunity to join us on Gloomhaven.
[b]Welcome![/b]

[h3]What about the specs tho?[/h3]

You will find below the minimum and recommended specs to run Gloomhaven on your beloved and dear macOS!

[b]MINIMUM[/b]
OS Version: Big Sur (11)
Processor: 2.7GHz
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: 4 GB

[b]RECOMMENDED[/b]
OS Version: Monterey (12)
Processor: 3.2GHz
Memory: 16 GB RAM
Graphics: 8 GB


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h1]DEVELOPMENT UPDATE[/h1]

[b]MERCENARIES![/b]
We heard you.
We received lots of feedback regarding the enhancements and randomness issues, and thanks to you all, we have been able to carefully evaluate and discuss these topics.
The next major update coming in December will thus implement the following changes:

[b]Enhancements:[/b]
We are working on implementing the permanent enhancements for the retirement system from the original board game to the Gloomhaven Digital Campaign. This will be a toggleable option in the campaign that will allow a mercenary to keep their enhancements after they’re retired. Consequently, if you or another member of your party wants to play the same character, the unlocked enhancements will remain. 
In the non-permanent enhancements mode, the enhancements’ pricing will be reduced and rebalanced to allow you to create new build ideas. These changes were approved by Isaac Childres and his team.

[b]Game variant - reduced randomness: [/b]
This board game variant allows players to reduce the variance in damage caused by the x2 (or “Bless”) and x0 (or “Curse”) attack modifiers by instead treating them as a +2 and -2 modifiers respectively.

> These are two of the numerous improvements and changes we will be bringing in the upcoming update next month.
We felt it was cool to let you know we were working on these specific two as there has been a huge demand and tons of feedback about it, and since we’re cool, too. <


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h1]VOTE FOR GLOOMHAVEN IN THE 
STEAM AWARDS[/h1]

[b]Steam Award Nominations are open now![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/9d17b53b6e588ade533e3c4c0cfc837d4b861f18.jpg[/img]

It would really mean a lot to us to even make the short list for an award, and we can think of none better than the "Best Game You Suck At" Award.

[b][i]"This is the game that rewards persistence, and is not for the faint of heart. It's the toughest game we've ever loved."[/i][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/nominations

So get your votes in and tell all your friends and family to do the same!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h1]JOIN THE GLOOMHAVEN COMMUNITY[/h1]
[b]we sweet[/b]

We also post fun content (*meeeeemes*) and share tips & tricks!

You can also join our dedicated Discord server here: discord.gg/gloomhaven to receive help and advice, meet other players and discuss any topic you want!
You will be received with tremendous friendliness and warmth!

notes.title: NEW DIFFICULTY MODES
notes.content:
[i]Oh, stop boasting mate! Yeah yeah, we heard you the first fifteen times, you killed a dragon. Not that anyone has ever seen a dragon here; might only be a big lizard for all we know. But if you're so tough, I've just heard about a bunch of new contracts available for “extra-seasoned mercenaries". Go ahead, and we’ll see you around. Or down under.

As for our green-blood right there, come here. You look a bit roughen up, don’t ya? No worries, it’s always hard the first time, but you made it home alive. That's a start, I s'pose. What contract did you take? That one?! That's for experienced mercenaries, rookie! Start with something more manageable and you'll be killing harrower infesters by the dozen later up the road.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h3]Our warmest greetings, esteemed mercenaries![/h3]

On this glorious day, spirits are high as we come bearing much loot of a very, very useful kind: a sizable update containing two new difficulty modes that will be available both in the Guildmaster and Campaign modes.
We have spent a lot of time taking into account all of your bug reports and feedback about the game as we launched it, and thanks to it, have been able to implement many improvements, small and big.
Without further ado, I will let you go and venture into these patch notes as they unravel the mysteries of this new update.

[h1]FACE TWO NEW DIFFICULTY MODES[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added - A new [b]Friendly Difficulty[/b] as well as a new [b]Deadly Difficulty[/b] setting (+3) for show-offs. These are both available in the Campaign & Guildmaster modes where Easy has been rebalanced.[/list]
[b]Friendly Difficulty: [/b]
- Blessed: Heroes start each scenario with +3 Blesses in their deck
- Healthy: Heroes have 50% more health
- Easy: Monsters, Traps and Gold will be 1 level lower

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/058482c05e7a00bd08034981a3bb2594af4a5c41.png[/img]

[b]Deadly Difficulty: [/b]
- Deadly: Monsters, Traps and Gold will be 3 levels higher

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/ab478ee9357e6978b9a900dec66e7667196980d7.png[/img]
