notes.title: Gloomhaven 1.0 available now
notes.content:
A band of battle-scarred mercenaries violently opens the door of the Sleeping Lion. Not the best tavern in town but not so shabby as to deter bounty hunters, ruffians and other unsavoury folks. Once seated, a beer in each hand, their leader clamors with a distinctive deep voice:
[i]“We’re back lads! Do you smell this? The scent of opportunity! We’ve left the city for two years, we’ve become Guildmasters and taken our fair share of loot, but Gloomhaven has called us home.”[/i]

With a quick glance, he notices several people whispering and counting their gold whilst looking around: 
[i]“It seems like work is back on the menu.”[/i]

Soon enough, a heteroclite group of small-time adventurers approaches him, seemingly confused:
[i]“Well, well, what do we have here? Green blood! Whaddaya want? A contract? An advice? A hug mayhap?”[/i]

Without giving them a chance to answer, the veteran mercenary grabs one of them by the collar and mumbles:
[i]“No hug for you, but let me give you a piece of advice, if you’re looking for mercenary work, we’ve heard there’s a Valrath looking for hired blades capable of tracking down some stolen documents. Go see her if it is in your line of work. Now get lost!”[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/32594c6565b56713bcd2b61a304deaad5f1e18ae.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[h1]GLOOMHAVEN 1.0 RELEASED[/h1]

[previewyoutube=8tQCpXixolE;full]https://youtu.be/8tQCpXixolE[/previewyoutube]

Esteemed mercenaries and guildmasters, will everyone please gather round?
Gloomhaven is finally 100% content complete and ready to be enjoyed by everyone out there. You will be able to play the entire board game campaign as well as the guildmaster one.
Here is what you can expect from Gloomhaven 1.0:
[list]
[*] The complete board game campaign (see more details below)
[*] A digital exclusive: the Guildmaster adventure (see more details below)
[*] 17 unique characters, each coming with their own skills
[*] Thousands of abilities, perks, items and enhancements
[*] Dark and challenging environments filled with dangerous enemies of all sorts
[*] A fully voiced board game campaign by Alec Newman
[*] Many improvements requested by the community over the 2 years of Early Access
[*] Less bugs, more stability, better performance
[*] All of the content is fully playable in online co-op up to four players 
[/list]
[h3]And, Gloomhavenologists?[/h3]
We wouldn't have made it this far, nor anywhere, without you, our community.
You’ve been supporting Gloomhaven in your own ways - whether buying the game on Steam, leaving us reviews, giving feedback and reporting bugs to help us improve the game, participating in building the community on Discord, Facebook or Twitter, or simply talking about Gloomhaven to your friends.
To think that our Discord server has now grown to more than 21,000 members and we just passed 4,500 Steam reviews, I mean, what a journey. Thank you.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[h2]EXPERIENCE THE BOARD GAME CAMPAIGN[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/fbd0bc33dee4aa763243ff6c8bd2c0030dee2a33.png[/img]

Coming from Gloomhaven the Board Game, Isaac Childres’ ultimate strategic board game and highest rated game of all time on [url=http://boardgamegeek.com]Board Game Geek[/url], this branching campaign of 95 story missions will pit your greed against your morality. Numerous powers are vying for control over the city of Gloomhaven while others are looking for ancient crypts and forgotten artefacts. You could always side with the inhabitants… but it may not pay well.

[h2]A DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE: GUILDMASTER ADVENTURE[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/91057d87a2b2daceca5857aad7051885a407420b.png[/img]

Created in cooperation with the community, the Guildmaster adventure offers over 160 digital exclusive missions to experience another facet of Gloomhaven. Lead your guild of mercenaries in a region overrun by far worse than simple bandits.
Choose the best combination of mercenaries for each fight and follow their character stories in dangerous new territories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]


[h1]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/h1]
[h3]LAUNCH DAY EDITION[/h3]

[b]How different is Gloomhaven Digital from the original board game?[/b]

A 1:1 adaptation was both not possible or desirable, as digital platforms and their gameplay have their own advantages and drawbacks compared to tabletop. Keep in mind that differences remain very minor and Gloomhaven Digital is a very faithful adaptation of the original gameplay and design.
Every difference implemented in Gloomhaven Digital was closely discussed and custom-tailored together with the original board game author, Isaac Childres, to ensure we stayed true to Gloomhaven's core design.

_______________________

[b]Do I need to buy the game again if I already bought the Early Access version?[/b]

No, of course not. If you already own Gloomhaven Digital, you will simply be prompted to download an update which will upgrade your Early Access version to the full 1.0 version. 

_______________________

[b]How long is the game?[/b]

It varies a lot depending on how you play. There are 250+ missions in the game, shared between the Guildmaster and Campaign modes.
That should be at least 150 hours of gameplay if you are super fast and never lose, probably above 200+ hours for most people.

_______________________

[b]Are my Early Access saves compatible with the 1.0 version?[/b]

Guildmaster saves will for sure be compatible, however, for Campaign Beta saves, we cannot make any promises right now, it might depend on when they have been created.

_______________________

[b]Should I start a fresh run?[/b]

Yes, we strongly suggest you start a fresh run as the Campaign is brand new.
It is also always a possibility to start a new one on the Guildmaster mode, but not necessary, as all saves (old and new) will have the same content.

_______________________

[b]How many players can play together online?[/b]

All of the content Gloomhaven has to offer (both the Guildmaster mode and the Campaign) is available for up to 4 players in co-op.

_______________________

[b]Can we expect further updates after that?[/b]

Yes, we will be patching and supporting the game after launch.
DLCs are also a possibility, but our main focus is supporting the base game and making sure it matches the players’ expectations.
Anyway, we’re not going to suddenly vanish.

_______________________

[b]Do you plan on supporting additional languages?[/b]

Our four languages at launch are English, French, German and Spanish. 
We can't promise anything else for now!

_______________________

[b]Will you release Gloomhaven on other platforms?[/b]

It will be available at launch on Steam and GoG, and supported on PC.
Our main focus for now is to make sure the game is absolutely the best it can be on these platforms before turning to anything else.

_______________________

[b]What about Gloomhaven on MacOS?[/b]

Initially, we wanted to release the MacOS version at launch, given that it would be stable and of a quality level we deemed appropriate for MacOS players.
As of right now, we haven’t met the standards we set for the MacOS version to be released, and thus we will keep on improving it until it can be released in a patch in the upcoming weeks.
Please believe this is one of our top priorities and we absolutely care about giving MacOS players the opportunity to join us on Gloomhaven.

_______________________

[b]What about bugs?[/b]

Gloomhaven is a colossal game with tens of thousands of possible abilities, items, perks, enhancements, enemies and overall combinations. While we have invested a massive amount of time and effort on fixing desynchronization issues and other bugs over the past year, you may still encounter issues in the multiplayer version of Gloomhaven.

If you experience crashes or freezes, or find any additional issues that break the game or hinder you from progressing in the game, please report them on our support portal. 
The devs would really appreciate it if you attach a video or a screenshot of the issue and all of the information you have available. That will help us a lot in our investigation!

You can find the support portal here:
https://asmodee.helpshift.com/hc/en/75-gloomhaven/

You can contact us directly here:
https://asmodee.helpshift.com/hc/en/75-gloomhaven/contact-us/

Known issue and workaround: if you encounter a multiplayer desynchronization, as the game is automatically saved at the end of each turn, you can simply reload the save, re-invite your friends using a new multiplayer code and then choose a different card combination.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png[/img]

[h1]JOIN THE GLOOMHAVEN COMMUNITY[/h1]
[b]we nice[/b]

As you venture through the lands of Gloomhaven in the newly released board game campaign, share with us your thoughts, screenshots, gameplay and virtually anything that you please on [url=https://twitter.com/Gloomhaven_Digi]Twitter[/url].
We also post fun content (*meeeeemes*) and share tips & tricks!

You can also join our dedicated Discord server here: discord.gg/gloomhaven to receive help and advice, meet other players and discuss any topic you want!
You will be received with tremendous friendliness and warmth!

notes.title: New skins available now! Come and grab what is yours.
notes.content:
[h3]Mercenaries, gather around and let's have a serious talk (with a few drinks, we're not savages).[/h3]

[b]We did say thank you for being an amazing, supportive and quite honestly all-around brilliant community, didn't we?[/b]

Time to show it with [b]two new skins[/b] that have been implemented in the latest patch! 

[i]*happy looting sounds*[/i]
Congratulations, with your support and awesomeness, you've unlocked Witch Doctor Mindthief and Mastermind Tinkerer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

We are implementing a special skin for both Mindthief and Tinkerer that are available for free to all [b]Early Access[/b] purchasers.

During character selection in your roster menu, these will be available for you to pick by clicking on the mask icon.

We've also prepared quite awesome visuals that you can check out below to see how great they look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

Mindthief learned her psychokinetic powers living in the sewers, it is now time for her to come back to her tribal roots and become a Witch Doctor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/fbb5047ca843ed329610df11b47b7d2c1721dfd3.jpg[/img]

Gather all of your brain power and prepare for 200IQ plays with our very own Mastermind Tinkerer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/afb05fffbde5db521f6acd53f92e61a43007d41a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Last Stitch new update is now available!
notes.content:
[i]You yell "Next!" as blood and sweat cover your face. They scream as you slash and cut through them, but you keep going. Because if you won’t do it, then who will?
You wipe your forehead with your arm and begin stitching back the wounded Quatryl laying on your table.
Diseases breed violence, and whatever end you see it from, both just mean more work for you. And of course, Demonsgate is filled with both in equally large amounts...
When the last patient is finally dealt with, you call for the mercenaries waiting for you and grab your saw.
When gangrene spreads, you cut the infected limb. When death is being spread, you also cut the madmen responsible for it, to make sure everyone comes back alive.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h1]BE READY TO LEAD YOUR GUILD ON A NEW ADVENTURE[/h1]

[b]Our warmest greetings, fellow guildmasters! [/b]
The latest release for Gloomhaven has now come upon us.
With this new chapter, you will be able to:
[list]
[*] Recruit the last mercenary
[*] Discover 5 new story missions
[*] Challenge 2 new bosses
[/list]
Careful, this trailer contains spoilers for the Saw mercenary:

[previewyoutube=budRmnel7hA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]JOIN US INTO THE LANDS OF GLOOMHAVEN[/h1]

Clear out dust on your wishlist this summer, with the Summer Sale!

[b]With a discount of 25% on Gloomhaven’s Early Access until July 8, it’s the perfect time to put a dent in that list of games you keep meaning to play![/b]

Be sure to spread the word to your friends, family and anyone who will have the wisdom to listen.
Journey through the lands of Gloomhaven together as you leave no chance to your adversaries. Prepare to face exciting challenges all while amassing fortune and fame!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/780290/Gloomhaven/

[h1]GRAB YOUR GOLD COINS & RECRUIT THE NEW MERCENARY IN TOWN[/h1]

Once back in the capital, your steps instinctively led you to the most popular and busy shopping street in the city. Along the long cobbled street, you hear chitter-chatter about a newcomer...


Gather around, guildmasters, as we welcome in our beautiful town the (Saw) [spoiler]Sawbones.
Humans are by far the most dominant of the races. Their society is one of rules and regulations, but also one of great diversity. Due to their intense curiosity and relentless nature, humans can find themselves walking almost any path imaginable – from the obscenely wealthy noble to the unappreciated tavern cook; from the blacksmith forging rugged weaponry to the corrupted pursuant of dark magics.

Perhaps one of the most respected professions in human society is to serve the Great Oak. 
Human Sawbones are religious healers operating under the Great Oak. They are respected members of society, but contrary to popular belief do not rely on magic for most of their healing prowess. 
This instead comes from knowledge passed from the researchers of the Great Oak.. and from the swift amputation of infected limbs. 

Followers of the Oak are religious healers who do their best to ward off the pestilence and death that can manifest in larger human cities. Contrary to popular belief, however, there is nothing miraculous about their healing methods, as anyone who has come to them with a gangrenous leg knows all too well. The mystique of the profession can get lost amongst the screams when the Sawbone has to hack off a limb.

Being an offensive support, Saw is an excellent melee damage-dealer with an incredible capacity for crowd control. As you recruit him, will you prefer his heavy crowd control or his healing and damage?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/df98ed2de8365650f74d1ce836e6296119fb99bb.jpg[/img]
[/spoiler]

[h1]TRAIN YOUR GUILD TO FACE BRAND NEW CHALLENGES[/h1] 

Take on any of the numerous new missions brought to you in The Last Stitch update.
As you venture into 5 new story missions and prepare yourself to face 2 new bosses, it is time to grab your weapons and find out what dark secrets and unimaginable treasures lie in wait for you in this chapter!
Be sure you are well-prepared…

[h1]AND OH, SO MUCH MORE![/h1]

Much more content and features await you in this new patch, including: [olist]
[*] A new item (spoiler)
[*] A new perk,  “added target”: this perk gives you the possibility to add an additional target as an attack modifier draw

notes.title: Discover and delve into The Resolute & the Virulent brand new update!
notes.content:
[i]A chittering hooded figure is getting assaulted in broad daylight- it has become a common occurrence in these days. Sadly for the aggressors, this one fights back; well... bites back? You're not sure really. 
As you're wondering about the proper nomenclature, the man starts screaming as he witnesses his flesh turning green then black, whilst his companions are drawing their weapons, unsure about what's happening. 
As soon as you move in to help the assailed, two other men drop dead on the floor, several black arrows piercing their back. As a tall character emerges from the shadows, the remaining assailants start running away from their certain doom. But can they really outrun this one?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h1]ADVANCE IN YOUR QUEST AS YOU FACE NEW CHALLENGES[/h1]

[b]Our warmest greetings, fellow guildmasters! [/b]
The latest release for Gloomhaven has arrived.
With this new chapter, you will be able to:
[list]
[*] Recruit 2 new mercenaries
[*] Discover 7 new story missions
[*] Challenge an all-new boss
[/list]
Careful, this trailer contains spoilers for Squid Face and Angry Face mercenaries:
[previewyoutube=3IOv70j4PCY;full][/previewyoutube]

Pack and plan intelligently before you embark on a journey through the lands of Gloomhaven with your friends and family. Prepare to face new challenges all while amassing fortune and fame!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/780290/Gloomhaven/

[h1]GATHER AROUND TO WELCOME THE NEWCOMERS![/h1]

Your steps have led you to the gates of the city. You have just heard the news: two newcomers are looking to join the fight. Will you succeed in recruiting them for your own guild?

Esteemed guildmasters, let me introduce you to the (Squid Face) [spoiler]Plagueherald.
Harrower Plagueheralds are a small sect of Harrowers who are one of the main reasons the entire species is in disrepute among polite Gloomhaven society.
Either misguided or ignorant of other races’ physiology, Plague Heralds believe that the spread of disease throughout a society will strengthen it and propel it towards great things.
“Harrower” is only the name given to this race in the common tongue, as the name in their own language of chitters and hisses cannot be easily translated. A single Harrower, as typically seen by other races, is actually a swarm of thousands of insects who have merged their intelligence to form a hive mind capable of highly sophisticated thought.
They are a squishy ranged character, and thus you will want to avoid putting yourself in a position to take hits. They specialize in reducing the effectiveness of enemies or putting debuffs on enemies that will make your allies’ attacks more effective through the use of Curse and Poison.
But be wary of allying with a Plagueherald, fellow adventurers, as their ability to spread decay and death across both sides of a battlefield is a terrifying thing to behold.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/c558c6343cb67c8a43ef1322238e683ce9f76ec2.jpg[/img]
[/spoiler]

Let me keep you around a little longer as yet another mercenary has arrived in town.
Meet the (Angry Face) [spoiler] Doomstalker!
Though most Orchids live a life of meditation, there is a sect who believes that enlightenment should be achieved through hard work and not getting lost in thought for years on end. Because of its beliefs, the sect fled Orchid society across the Misty Sea to build farms and raise livestock in the wilds around Gloomhaven. The wilds are still dangerous, however, and the Orchid class of Doomstalkers is tasked with keeping these modest settlements safe. 
The calm mind of the Orchid makes the Doomstalker an excellent bow hunter. He never misses a shot. The Doomstalker is a medium-hp, giant hand-size ranged damage-dealer. And ranged damage-dealer he is, as he can inflict some really high damage from quite far away. His Doom mechanic also means that he has a unique rhythm to his playstyle that you will need to learn to master.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/060e3109b7041d30cd0b099803255e616996879c.jpg[/img]
[/spoiler]

[h1]COMPLETE NEW MISSIONS AND FACE A NEW BOSS[/h1] 

Take on any of the numerous new missions brought to you in The Resolute & The Virulent update! 
Recruit, expand and train your team of mercenaries as you venture into 7 new story missions and prepare yourself to face a brand new boss.
It is time to grab your weapons and find out what dark secrets and unimaginable treasures lie in wait for you in this chapter!

notes.title: Hotfix v.19545
notes.content:
[h1]Hotfix v.19545[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added - A few missing perks for some classes
[*] Updated - Environment art and lighting, both visual and performance improvements
[*] Fixed - Issue with enhancements on [spoiler]Summoner's[/spoiler] summons not applying to the second summon ability

[*] Fixed - Applying Single Target Items/Active Bonuses to Merged abilities
[*] Fixed - Multiple random desync issues in multiplayer
[/list]

Known Issues
[list]
[*] Multiplayer - Clicking actions quickly on the UI can lead to desyncs on some lower-end hardware configurations. We are working on a fix but in the meantime, if you are experiencing issues in multiplayer, you can try ensuring players are not rapidly clicking on buttons and/or using hotkeys to confirm actions.
[*] Multiplayer - Players can sometimes desync at the end of a scenario. We have a fix coming for this shortly.
[*] Multiplayer - Reassigning players in the middle of a round can lead to issues at the start of the next round.
[*] Multiplayer - Desync can occur after [spoiler]Beast Tyrant Bear [/spoiler]summoning. We've added some additional logging for this so please send an error report if you hit this issue.
[/list]

notes.title: Gather around adventurers, as The Wise & The Resourceful update is now available
notes.content:
[i]Three days. It has been three days since you entered this godsforsaken dungeon. 
The Brute has shattered his sword and now fights with his bare fists while your armor has more holes than leather at this point... 
Oh, you were prepared! You brought food, water...you even had a PLAN! 
Well it wasn't enough. The bones are rattling again behind the door, searching for you and you are stuck with this useless glyph. 
Even the Spellweaver could not decipher it as it kept phasing in and out. 
Your employer paid you well, that’s true, but why does she keep sending you to these deadly places looking for useless rocks? 
If only you had listened and used the gold to recruit the newcomers...[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1]PREPARE YOURSELF FOR A NEW ADVENTURE[/h1]

The latest release for Gloomhaven has arrived.
With this new chapter, you will be able to recruit two new mercenaries to your guild, complete 7 new missions and face a new boss!

Careful, this trailer contains spoilers for Circles and Three Spears mercenaries:
[previewyoutube=4H8svmwSEx4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]HAVE YOU HEARD THE NEWS? GOOD THINGS COME IN TWO’S[/h1]

As the new chapter is released, so are discounts to accompany it.
If you haven’t created your own guild in Gloomhaven yet, then this might be the decisive factor you were waiting for! 

[b]Until March 29th, Gloomhaven’s Early access is discounted by 20% as a part of the Play Together initiative on Steam.[/b]

Be sure to spread the word to your friends, family and anyone who will have the wisdom to listen. 
Journey through the lands of Gloomhaven together as you leave no chance to your adversaries, all while amassing fortune and fame!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/780290/Gloomhaven/

[h1]LISTEN, DEAR GUILDMASTERS, AND RECRUIT THE TWO NEWCOMERS[/h1]

Two new mercenaries have arrived in town and are looking for a guild to join. 
Come and show them how we greet newcomers in Gloomhaven!

Fellow mercenaries, welcome to town the (Three Spears) [spoiler]Quartermaster.
Though their demon-like qualities make them feared by many, Valrath Quartermasters pride themselves on integrating well into the rest of inter-species society. It is not uncommon, then, for an army or city garrison to employ a Valrath as a Quartermaster. 
But lucky for you, guildmasters, skilled Quartermasters have also been known to aid smaller adventuring parties.
He is a versatile melee character who can occasionally tank as well as support allies by maximizing the effectiveness of their equipment. After all, what is a warrior without a good sword at his side? 
But do not let it fool you, as his ability to lend a hand to his team surely doesn’t lessen his prowess to master multiple weapons and skills.
The only other question you will have to answer is just how much you want to use his support side compared to his damage and tanking capacities. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bd2608d7e1ec79cb49553e3b117857604b6b2cc4.jpg[/img][/spoiler]

Do not leave yet as we are also here to formally introduce you to another new mercenary.
Meet the (Circles) [spoiler] Summoner!
Being an Aesther Summoner, she is a particular type of Aesther.
Her thirst for knowledge often gets the best of her and entices her to use their reality-bending powers to hunt it down. As a Summoner, she has learnt to coordinate her interplanar existence to transport anything, imaginable or not, between planes.
However, this quickly exhausts her, so she will often stick to living things and raw energy, which are easiest to summon.
She is a powerful range character who can both summon allies to the battlefield to support the party, and summon "raw energy" from across the planar boundaries in the form of ranged attacks. Her magic abilities arsenal is formidable, but it will be a challenge to learn how to make use of summoned allies effectively. Be humble and wise as your progress!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/c7d48519dbfcb3c6c65739a71628bbff9709d3bb.jpg[/img][/spoiler]

[h1]FACE ONE NEW BOSS AND DISCOVER 7 NEW MISSIONS![/h1] 

Take on any of the numerous new missions that are available in The Wise & The Resourceful update! With this new patch, 7 new story missions have just been revealed and you will also have to face a new boss; so grab your weapons and find out what this newest update has in store for you.


[h1]ADDITIONAL AMELIORATIONS[/h1]

We have also included some extra improvements and reworks in this new patch.
[list]
[*]3 cards missing from previous characters have been added
[/list]UI and UX tweaks have been made to improve the overall gameplay experience:
[list]
[*]Target selection rework
[*]Hex targeting rework
[/list]

[h1]LOOKING TO THE FUTURE…WITH YOU[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/237f69be30c6fcb03b5e4786db76df58f4430026.jpg[/img]

[h1]COME AND JOIN THE GLOOMHAVEN COMMUNITY[/h1]

As you go and discover all of this new content, fellow adventurers, share with us your thoughts, screenshots and gameplay on Twitter (https://twitter.com/Gloomhaven_Digi) and by joining the Facebook group (https://www.facebook.com/groups/GloomhavenDigital).

You can also join our dedicated Discord server here: discord.gg/gloomhaven to gain new player help, meet with other players and discuss about the update and the many classes.
You will be received with tremendous friendliness and warmth!

notes.title: Sewers update now available!
notes.content:
[i]“As you walk through the streets of Gloomhaven a foul stench awakens your senses. Your head immediately jerks up at the sudden odour that permeates your very being. As you gaze around you notice a group of mercenaries which are walking past, covered in a variety of severe injuries, slime and waste… as you glance back along the path of wet footprints they left, you notice they lead to an open sewer grate in the city’s street. You wonder what would drive adventurers to explore such a horrible place, then it dawns on you; fame and gold! You hurry to your guild, ready to lead your mercenaries on a new adventure!”[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/780290/Gloomhaven/

[h1]PREPARE TO VENTURE INTO THE SEWERS[/h1]
The latest release for Gloomhaven has arrived; prepare to adventure into the dark and seedy underbelly of the city, a place where disgusting, dangerous and powerful foes lurk. In this new update, we will be releasing a mass of new content that you will be able to explore, combat and use to your advantage! With an entirely new Biome, the Sewers, you will encounter four new enemies, a new boss, and even two new mercenaries that have found their way into town!

Careful, this trailer contains spoilers:
[previewyoutube=3TjxnJpiVXk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]WINTER HAS COME TO GLOOMHAVEN, SO TO HAVE SALES![/h1]
If the frigid winds outside, or the cries of your friends have not already lured you to create your own guild in Gloomhaven, then this might do the trick! Until January 05, Gloomhaven’s Early access is discounted by 32% as a part of the Steam Winter Sale. Be sure to tell your friends, family, Inox neighbour and anyone else who will listen. Travel the lands of Gloomhaven together as you crush your foes, gaining fame and fortune in the process!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/780290/Gloomhaven/

[h1]GATHER YOUR MERCENARIES: TWO NEW RECRUITS HAVE ARRIVED![/h1] 
Two powerful new mercenaries have managed to find their way to this town and are looking for a guild to join. 

Recruit the (Eclipse) [spoiler] Nightshroud; not only the first Aesther to join your guild, but he is a powerful melee character who is capable of dealing large amounts of damage and has easy access to stealth abilities.The Nightshroud does however suffers from subpar movement options and inconsistent damage, so make sure you equip and build your team for this!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/678bfb5c5c5b2fcf41c0b19a4d343f3e4da51e14.jpg[/img] [/spoiler]

Don’t forget that the (Phoenix) [spoiler] Beast Tyrant has arrived in town as well. This mercenary is a powerful Vermling accompanied by an unbearably massive companion! This means that this mercenary has the bonus of working with 2 health bars. He is an effective tank, wielding powerful crowd control capabilities and numerous unique summons. But be wary of your bear, it has a mind of its own so controlling it correctly is the key to your success!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/99835a558c0cf9ac42f91b7441b1a7be3a5b3641.jpg[/img] [/spoiler]

[h1]FACE FOUR NEW CREATURES AND JOURNEY ON 18 NEW MISSIONS![/h1] 
Take on any of the numerous new missions that are available in The Sewers update! With this new patch, 7 story, 4 relic and 7 journey missions have just been revealed by the town crier; so grab your weapons and find out what dark secrets and unimaginable treasures lie in wait for you! On top of this, alongside being able to visit these new zones, you will also encounter 4 ghastly new enemies!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/c6b0c1d479df789b889fa366901c0db673f8dbb3.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/7f5f91ddb541985c2b2f31cf6bbd7ad06ada24f3.jpg[/img][/url]  [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/93ddc6add38edff5007a7fcfcc28c6db8e1ba4f9.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/f9ff64cd6904dacf2eb0c9fd8054459021abdd33.jpg[/img][/url]  [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/33574f240040b6c59744433dffda8146dd4494c7.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/8871c87820ce52e7873f577aec18d4736d59b0bd.jpg[/img][/url]  [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/86fd2146eb7e9748f7502643782373df3c82afc7.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/4386fa5f9de8f8c4c3ffcea36eb01b723d1289b9.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]CHANGES TO MODDING[/h1]
We have made extensive changes to the YML for this release in order to improve things for modding. The downside of this is that all gameplay mods are invalidated by this change and will need to be updated before they work again (language mods will still work though). The current release only supports Language mods as we are still in progress with the rest of this change, but once it is released we will support a lot of new functionality that has been asked for by the modding community.

Please read the full details here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/780290/discussions/0/5575984402938252279/

[h1]AND OH, SO MUCH MORE…[/h1]
Much more awaits you in this new patch, including an all new [b]Multiplayer ping system[/b] which can be used with a simple double click on a hexagon, [b]bug fixes[/b], [b]UI/UX updates and tweaks[/b], new features and far more. Be sure to head on over to the Sleeping Lion and gather your guildmates to explore the world as it continues to open up before you! If you’re interested in seeing the full list of changes in The Sewers patch, be sure to review the full patch notes here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/780290/discussions/0/1643169167151064379/#c2994296376456544564

[h1]LOOKING TO THE FUTURE...[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/f5cc21374bb78e29e3370d8104ef238f52e86637.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Gloomhaven’s third community challenge starts now!
notes.content:
[i]“The queue stretched as far as the eye could see—at the end of it laid a small table with someone wearing a monocle seated at it, with a pen frantically scratching paper. Taking on a tone that was sometimes delighted, sometimes sullen, he made a list of the people who came to him. Those given a small purse went to the right, the others who were rejected went to the left; often followed by a "NEXT!". It's been a long time since we hired so many mercenaries for an adventure! This one had to be immense to have to solicit so many warriors and mages.”[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h1]OUR COMMUNITY CHALLENGES CONTINUE![/h1]

Let’s keep unlocking some exclusive skins for our mercenaries, shall we?! 
Let's see ... Following the arrival of the Scoundrel skin to the Early Access, after already unlocking the Brute skin by defeating a colossal mass of enemies in a limited time. You also managed to enlist a good number of mercenaries on the official Discord, thus unlocking the skin of the Spellweaver.

[b]This time around, Cragheart is next on the list!
[/b]
Here is a quick look of what you can expect from this skin: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/ae20a909c24797760b1bd2a09d8dfd379a046a35.jpg[/img]

[h1]GATHER YOUR GROUP OF ADVENTURERS: THE MULTIPLAYER WEEK BEGIN![/h1]

To unlock the Cragheart skin, this time you will have to complete as many dungeons as you can in online co-op! 

[b]You have one week (until 08/12) to complete 12,500 scenarios, as a community. 
[/b]
Join the thousands of daily players and combine forces in the online co-op mode to complete as many scenarios as you can! If you manage to accomplish this challenge, you will be awarded the Cragheart skin!

If you are looking for mercenaries to play with, the best way is still to[b] join our Discord server[/b] and post a message in the dedicated channel: https://discord.gg/Gloomhaven

[h1]A FEW WORDS ABOUT THE COMMUNITY CHALLENGES, IF YOU MAY…[/h1]

We have noted during previous community challenges the mistrust of some with regard to the setting up of these events, which could potentially affect the smooth running and progress of Early Access.

[b]Note that the inclusion of exclusive skins in no way affects the work rate of the team in charge. 
[/b]
There are many jobs within the same team, and the setting up of these events is not a priority over the general progress of Early Access. The addition of a new skin does not in any way differ from the dates indicated on the roadmap! Our goal is to offer you exclusive and challenging content while waiting for the arrival of the next major update! We hope that many of you will take part in the challenge!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

Good luck to you, guildmasters! We hope you will be numerous to survive the dark dungeons of Gloomhaven during this event!

notes.title: Two new mercenaries have arrived in town. Welcome to the city streets!
notes.content:
[i]“Another street fight broke out... it was commonplace in the lower town. This time however, the crowd around the two concerned caught your attention. As you get closer, you manage to discern an imposing horned figure in the crowd, obviously settling her score with a thief who had the misfortune of trying to steal her purse full of gold. A new mercenary has arrived in town—and it seems that she was not alone. A figure covered in armor put an end to the combat, separated the attackers and settled the conflict in a few well thought words. Her large, mysterious eyes displayed considerable pride and disdain. Maybe a second recruit for your guild?”[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h1]TWO STRONG AND SOLID MERCENARIES ARE WAITING TO BE RECRUITED[/h1]

Always eager to prove herself in a challenge, the first mercenary is a warrior willing to go to any lengths to keep her people safe, including sacrificing her own life. Careful, as the more wounded she becomes, the more dangerous it becomes to fight against her! Welcome the [b][spoiler]Berserker![/spoiler][/b]

[spoiler][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/43674bf372ca8a723bd35cbc22cfb41f04bb5c95.jpg[/img][/spoiler]

The second mercenary who joined the fight is from a unique race never seen in the Early Access… They often travel the world, seeking out situations where they can demonstrate their brilliant powers. Proud and diplomatic, you can count on her abilities to protect your fellow mercenaries. Recruit the [b][spoiler]Sunkeeper![/spoiler][/b]

[spoiler][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/72b5738eb0a12f48de0064d0c6ca2408dd52959c.jpg[/img][/spoiler]

[h1]WELCOME TO TOWN: THE CITY STREETS AND ITS ENEMIES ARE NOW AVAILABLE![/h1]

Discover the all-new biome and venture out with your mercenaries along the city streets. From the merchant lane, to the upper town, pass through the shacks, walk the alleys with your mercenaries and enjoy the new features of this specific biome! 
[list][*] Rediscover [b]the third AI adapted to the city streets[/b]: several criminals roam the city, and you can count on the guards to help you stop them. On the other hand, you too are a potential target for anyone with enough money to put on your head … 
[*] Begin a scenario with [b]your mercenaries scattered around the map[/b]! Your team of mercenaries will start the scenario scattered alone or in pairs in different rooms. Time to adapt your strategies to regroup and to eliminate every enemy encountered.[/list]
With the brand new city biome comes fearsome new enemies! Do not be fooled by the presumed prosperity of the place: you are bound to attract unwanted attention during your journey in town… Keep an eye on them, and make sure to always stay on your guard, for many dangers are hiding behind the apparent calm of the streets: 
[list]
[*] City Archer
[*] City Guard
[*] Ancient artillery
[*] Harrower Infester
[*] A new boss: [spoiler][b]Merciless Overseer[/b][/spoiler]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/ccb74dda0fddf81ade024561ba50935b94bab6b1.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW QUESTS ADDED: A DARK CONSPIRACY IS BREWING IN TOWN... [/h1]

Restore peace and order through several new missions, guildmasters! 
[list]
[*] [b]7 story missions[/b]: you will soon learn that a terrible plot is at work in the city. Whether it is for gold, fame or justice, you are the only one who can dismantle this organization and save an entire people.
[*] [b]2 relic missions[/b]: powerful items could greatly help your Guild members during their missions… 
[*] [b]10 journey missions[/b]: the map is getting bigger! Discover new places and pocket gold coins by completing the journey missions.
[/list]
[h1]MADE A MISTAKE? USE THE NEW “RESTART ROUND” OPTION![/h1]

Adding an “undo button” was definitely one of the most requested features since the beginning of Early Access. We took your feedback into account and we are pleased to announce that the “[b]Restart Round[/b]” option is now available. Once the round restarted, the seed of the enemies’ moves won’t change. You can now redo your last actions safely to recover from a grave mistake that might have been made in error and change the previously selected cards. 

[h1]REPORT YOUR BUGS DIRECTLY FROM THE GAME[/h1]

You will also be welcomed by an all-new [b]bug report option in game[/b]! From now on, when you will be encountering an error pop up, you will be able to report the issue directly from the game. The main advantage is that your save will automatically be sent to the developers, along with your report. This will greatly help us investigate the various bugs. Our community means a lot to us and we are very grateful for all the help we are receiving during this Early Access! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

All this great news is without counting the amount of new items added, the UI improvements and bugs fixed! Make sure to read the full patch notes [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/780290/discussions/0/1643169167151064379/]here[/url].


The city’s gates are now open, waiting for you, guildmasters! Battle through death and despair to satisfy your greed!

notes.title: Introducing the new Online Co-op Mode & an all-new mercenary
notes.content:
[i]“Once back in the capital, your steps instinctively led you to the most popular and busy shopping street in the city. Along the long cobbled street, many merchants scammed discounts, invitations to visit a store or to taste a local specialty. Your gaze nonetheless lingered on a small fountain, in which several pieces of copper and sometimes even shirt buttons were withering away. Sitting on the stone edge, a young Quatryl, lute in hand, hummed a song. When she noticed that her performance was being carefully listened to, she smiled at you. After whispering the last words and the last music chord, she held out her feathered hat towards you, obviously looking for some gold coins for the performance you just listened to …” [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
Greetings mercenaries! 

We have great news for you today!
Online co-op multiplayer mode is now available, a new mercenary can be unlocked and much more! Enemies, biomes, items … Discover the new update in our trailer: 

[previewyoutube=aZu0NteY0O0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]ONLINE MULTIPLAYER CO-OP MODE: OFFICIAL RELEASE![/h1]

First, the release of the online co-op mode! Highly requested by the community, this feature is now yours. Fight alongside your friends up to 4 players and defeat your enemies! 

We are very proud to be able to offer you a stable and complete version of the multiplayer co-op mode! Thanks to your feedback and involvement, we were able to resolve a high number of bugs. Thank you very much for your help. You worked hard for it, so don't wait any longer and dive into the adventure with your friends!

For those who wish to meet players and fellow travelers to go hunting, our official discord remains the best place to meet people! A dedicated channel has been created, where you can meet other players to play with. A tall and strong mercenary or a discreet and cunning assassin, you will certainly find the person you are looking for! To join our discord, click [url=https://discord.gg/4Nrk6zh]here[/url] and visit the #multiplayer_text_chat channel. 

[b]Remember![/b] The game is still in Early Access, and encountering bugs is commonplace. If you want to help us solve them, you are welcome on our official [url=https://discord.gg/4Nrk6zh]discord[/url] or on our dedicated platform [url=https://asmodee.helpshift.com/a/gloomhaven/?contact=1]here[/url].

[h1]FIGHT IN RHYTHM WITH THE NEW MERCENARY[/h1]

We are also welcoming a brand new mercenary! For all the board game players here, have you already guessed it?! Advance in the adventure to unlock this new mysterious character. Complete its story missions, learn about its past and convince it to join your Guild. Don't be fooled by its apparent softness, you will be wiped out in a snap … 

To all the mercenaries out there who wish to brave the spoilers, and discover this new character, here it is:
[spoiler]Her big eyes and soft voice might have already convinced you: the Soothsinger is now available![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/4b0094c24f37fc2d25c45b618af4972f289cff82.jpg[/img][/spoiler]

[h1]THERE ARE PLENTY OF ENEMIES IN THESE CAVES[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/b54b1515103626bbf5973cdf22da70883bb75526.jpg[/img]

Kill one, ten more will appear.
Once more, terrible enemies have joined the fight and are lurking in the shadows, waiting for a distracted and naive adventurer. But we know you are not this kind of mercenary. You are a professional. To help you in your quest, check the list of the gloomy creatures you will encounter from now on: 
[list]
[*] Flame Demon
[*] Wind Demon
[*] Frost Demon
[*] Earth Demon
[*] Savvas Lavaflow
[*] Savva Icestorm
[/list]
[h1]NEW QUESTS FOR YOUR GUILD[/h1]

As your Guild has grown in popularity more clients are requesting jobs from you, a slew of new missions is now available. You’ll have plenty of work to do, Guildmaster! Your efforts and victories have not gone unnoticed in the area, and here are 25 new missions available for you:
[list]
[*] 7 new story missions, in search of a mysterious adventurer missing seeking for revenge.
[*] 8 relic-jobs missions, for treasure hunters …
[*] 10 journey missions, to restore peace among the roads and unlock new areas on the map!
[/list]
You can check the huge patch notes in detail [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/780290/discussions/0/1643169167151064379/]here[/url]. 

[h1]ENJOY A 32% DISCOUNT![/h1]

Good news never arrives on its own! Enjoy a 32% discount on Gloomhaven Early Access until September 21st. Bring your friends on this adventure and play together thanks to the online mode co-op!

[h1]WHAT’S NEXT?[/h1]

We know perfectly well that these new features will not satisfy you for long ... Your thirst for adventure and battle betrays you, mercenaries. This is why the team continues to consolidate your reports, correct the bugs encountered, add content and work on the next features and characters. Have a look at our updated road map and what is coming next! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/aaa1c7de06ed41d710efa428ddb9be11ed05c053.jpg[/img]

All of this would not be possible without your help and involvement in the project. Thank you for being an incredible community! We can’t wait for your feedback over this new update! 


Death is all that awaits you in the gloom …

notes.title: ONLINE CO-OP MODE | OPEN BETA
notes.content:
[i]"How good it was to meet at your favorite table at the Sleeping Lion's Inn! Several mugs in hand, you manage to make your way through the mercenaries and locals who were feasting for whatever reason the beer gave them. Once you reached your table, you found your group of mercenaries counting the gold coins collected during your mission. An entire dungeon of bandits nullified—no survivors—and pockets full of gold coins, this is why you raise a glass tonight.”[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1]SURROUND YOURSELF WITH ONLY THE STRONGEST OF MERCENARIES[/h1]

The feature you've all been waiting for is now available on the open beta branch! Go for it now and [b]join the open beta to test the online co-op mode![/b]
The online co-op mode allows you to play online with your companions, train your group of mercenaries and set off against the hordes of enemies that inhabit the world of Gloomhaven. You will need to show strategy, cohesion and teamwork if you hope to triumph over your enemies.

As it is still in beta, prepare to face enemies of all kinds including … bugs! The goal of this open beta is to gather your feedback, your experiences and the potential bugs encountered in order to improve and refine, among other things, the stability of this new feature. 
If you encounter an issue and if you wish to help us resolve it, please make sure to contact us here: https://asmodee.helpshift.com/a/gloomhaven/?contact=1 and provide as many details as you can gather (screenshots, recordings, quests, save file and logs). You can also join our official Discord here: https://discord.gg/4Nrk6zh

[h1]HOW TO JOIN THE OPEN BETA AND PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS?[/h1]

To find the open beta version of the game:
[list]
[*] Right click on Gloomhaven in your Steam library
[*] Select properties
[*] Go to the betas tab
[*] Select the Open Beta branch included in that dropdown list
[*] Wait for your game to update
[/list]
By default, this new build will create a separate, new save file.


To launch an online game: 
[list]
[*] Load a save game
[*] Click on “escape” and select “Multiplayer”
[*] You’re now the host of this game! 
[*] Share the code with your friends, or add your Steam friends to the party 
[*] Click on “Join the session” to enter the code and you will be added to the game
[/list]
Please note that every party member can keep a save of the current game, and continue to play without the initial host. Also, any of your friends can join the game, at any time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
Thank you for your patience while waiting for the online co-op mode. We hope you’ll enjoy it as much as we do. Since it is still in open beta, we need your feedback in order to polish this feature so keep sharing your thoughts and the issues encountered along the way! 

Have fun roaming the dark dungeons with your friends!

notes.title: The all-new Guildmaster update is now live!
notes.content:
[i]“You carefully take out the pendant and hand it to the merchant. His gaze becomes more attentive as he looks at the relic. He swiftly takes his eyeglass out of his pocket and brings it to his eye. Carefully, he takes infinite time examining the jewel from every angle.
"By the gods! Do you have any idea about the value of this item?!" 
His gaze then falls almost by reflex on the Mindthief behind you, the last mercenary to have joined your guild. Clearly, the Vermling made a culprit of choice in the theft of such an object. You quickly take the object from the merchant's hand and put it back in your satchel.
"The relic comes from an abandoned temple in the mountains, I did not steal it.
- Damn lucky guy! adds the merchant, you could get a good price if you sold it!"
It is an option to consider ... But you could feel the magic emanating from the medallion. Keep it, for now, it may be useful for your future missions.”[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

Greetings! 

We are delighted to announce that the new update for Gloomhaven is available! This is the biggest update ever offered since the start of Early Access. 
Will you prove yourself worthy of the role of Guildmaster?

[h1]A NEW ADVENTURE AWAITS YOU![/h1]

Thanks to your support, your multiple constructive feedback on the various platforms, we are excited to be able to offer you a brand new game mode, officially replacing the Adventure mode. With the arrival of the Guildmaster update, discover a whole new experience of Gloomhaven’s Early Access, more engaging and more immersive. 

Here are few of many changes implemented in the Guildmaster update:

[list]
[*] Manage freely your roster of mercenaries at any point of your adventure.
[*] Revamped the out-of-dungeon experience with new missions/objectives/stories.
[*] Reworked the tutorial and introduction to gameplay mechanics.
[*] Cave biome and its monsters added.
[*] Co-op multiplayer in closed beta.
[/list]

Check [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/780290/view/2218533026448118643]this blog post[/url] if you wish to learn more about the Guildmaster update. 


[previewyoutube=kiEiiFR1olE;full][/previewyoutube]



As a guildmaster, you have decided to take advantage of the current conflict climate to fill your pockets with gold coins. While the world is torn apart following the massive appearance of bandits and monsters of all kinds, your tactical skills will surely prove to be effective for the inhabitants. Make trade routes safe again by ridding the region of these annoyers!
Recruit, discover, and train your teams of mercenaries, and immerse yourself in the world of Gloomhaven. 

[h1]ENHANCE YOUR SUMMER WITH A 25% DISCOUNT[/h1]

Summer is coming and with it a chance to test the latest update with a 25% discount! Take advantage of the summer sale, from June 25 to July 9, on Steam.
Add a breath of fresh air to your Steam library this season by becoming a Guild Master!

[h1]CO-OP MODE AVAILABLE IN CLOSED-BETA[/h1]

One of the topics you’re most waiting for! As announced in a previous blog post, the co-op multiplayer is now available in closed-beta for a short period. In the following weeks, this very awaited feature will be released into open beta, where everyone will be able to try it on a dedicated steam branch! 
That decision was taken in order to provide you with a stable version of the multiplayer co-op mode. We refuse to deliver a rushed adaptation of it, and the closed-beta is a way to gather feedback from our most dedicated players and resolve the last issues remaining before launching it in open beta.
 
As usual, we count on your feedback, bug reports and suggestions to improve it and deliver at the end the best adaptation of the initial board game. You have an impact on the way we intend to deliver the final version of the game and we’re grateful to have a community so involved in this project. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

Thank you so much for your continued support and be on the lookout for the next updates! 

Good luck on the formation of your Guild, mercenaries and stay safe out there!

notes.title: Begin your quest and explore the lands of Gloomhaven
notes.content:
[i]“The sun was strong this afternoon. Your steps were heavy on the stiff earth and the stones of the imperial road. To this must be added the endless political speeches of the wealthy nobleman who paid you a favorable sum to be escorted to the neighboring city ... The undead and other monstrosities that prowled the lowlands made every excursion outside the cities perilous. This contract was an opportunity to pocket a tidy sum, given the status of your employer. That said, your group of mercenaries does not go unnoticed and you feared an ambush at each crossing. And rightly so…”[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
Greetings mercenaries! 

Let us introduce you to another aspect of the upcoming Guildmaster update scheduled for the 25th June! This content release will bring you a whole new look at the game, with a greater immersion, especially thanks to the management of your Guild and its members and the variety of missions that will present themselves to you. The story lines and the way they have been exploited is all new! Therefore, to all the board gamers out there, you’ll be able to rediscover the lore of Gloomhaven from a new perspective! We hope this new content will delight you, as well as the neophytes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/364be21bb18884b2c2486c386190fbd60afa9b9f.jpg[/img]

Since the bandits and monsters made their way through the lands, people are afraid to leave their homes, making impossible trades and connections between towns. As a guild master, your mission will be to make the roads safer, not without filling your pockets in the process … Let’s see further what this journey has in store for you! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h2]NEW TYPES OF QUESTS ARE WAITING FOR YOU![/h2]

[b]Journey missions[/b]
These missions are taken to unlock new locations. Once your group of mercenaries is recruited, you’ll be able to explore the map and different towns and places thanks to the journey missions. The more you’ll explore, the more the map will be revealed to you. Liberating the region will also provide you with new missions to do and a handful of goods stocking your Merchant’s inventory! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/357249f3aad973704ddbeb3716fd2710f2b16bf3.jpg[/img]

[b]Story missions[/b]
Once certain locations are unlocked, you’ll be able to try your luck in recruiting a mercenary! Each one of them will also bring a unique story line to the table. Learn more about their past and motivations thanks to these new immersive quests! 

[b]Relic missions[/b]
These quests are unlocked by the Trainer and give you access to secret, powerful artefacts scattered throughout the lands of Gloomhaven. 

[b]Job missions[/b]
As a guild master, your priority is to make gold, by exploiting the current context in which the region is struggling with. The Job quests are the recurring missions that will allow you to earn, among other things, money, experience and other generic rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h2]MISSIONS OBJECTIVES AND DUNGEON MODIFIERS ARE HERE!
[/h2]
In addition to all this, each quest you carry out will be punctuated by very specific mission objectives, such as defeating a specific enemy, killing as many enemies as possible or protecting a character... Adapt your strategy and the management of your cards in order to fulfill the mission objectives! 
We are also adding modifiers! These will also deeply affect the way you play in a dungeon: a mission that appears to be a milk run would sound different if all your mercenaries started it wounded, right ?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bea8fd5a004e296df076a583f9a187f98f540e84.jpg[/img]

More missions are to come! As new content and new mercenaries are added, you’ll be able to discover their unique stories through dedicated quests! We will also bring new modifiers and objectives for the dungeons to get closer to the huge content of the board game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h2]SAVE THE DATE: LIVE Q&A WITH FLAMING FOWL STUDIOS!
[/h2]
We are sure you still have plenty of questions about the upcoming Guildmaster update. Join us for a Q&A live session, on Discord, on June 24, 16:00 CET!

[url=https://discord.gg/7ZMCvn8][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/7ff972d64fdf2e114b5bb98ab9e84dad3885317d.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/7ZMCvn8]Here is the link to join our official Discord server.[/url] Ask your questions about the update in #qa_questions chat channel.
The Flaming Fowl Studios team, which develops the game, will answer as many questions as they can, in order to explain the new upcoming content to you in detail. Make sure to be there, mercenaries!

notes.title: Learn more about the new Guildmaster Mode and its systems!
notes.content:
[i]“Once you’ve purchased a few potions and your equipment was ready, you faced your group. The Scoundrel finished sharpening her knives, while the Tinkerer tightened the last bolts of its latest wacky invention. Who knows what kind of damage that little thing could do thanks to the enchantress...
On the good advice of the trainer, you are about to go to the neighboring town to inquire about bandits who are demanding a tax from the surrounding farmers.
The merchant gave you a broad smile and wished you well, knowing full well that the sponsor had called in professionals. After a short visit to the temple, to ensure the good will of the gods, you head towards the exit of the capital, ready to start hunting…”[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
Greetings mercenaries! 

Following our last announcement about the upcoming Guildmaster mode, we wanted to share with you more details about it! As you may know, the current Adventure mode will be replaced by the Guildmaster mode on June 25, in which you’ll discover a more immersive and progressive gameplay. It is indeed a new way of looking at the game, while adding as you go along, essential bricks of content for us to build the final campaign.

[previewyoutube=veT3A_YjGII;full][/previewyoutube]

This time, we’ll talk about the Guild itself, and which improvements it brings. As the continent faces the arrival of bandits and monsters, the roads are not safe anymore. As a guildmaster, this is an opportunity for you and your mercenaries to make a few gold coins out of this mess.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h2]UNLOCK YOUR FAVORITE MERCENARIES AND SWITCH ROSTERS[/h2]

The first step will be unlocking your mercenaries scattered across the map. Here, you will have to recruit them yourself through dedicated [b]missions[/b]! The game starts with Brute from the tutorial and you will then proceed to unlock the other five starting characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/b4c4d04deb02061c633d58a1125c964cf4dbb883.jpg[/img]

Once your team is assembled, the new Guild interface will allow you to [b]change your roster[/b]. Between each dungeon and quest, you will be able to customize your company as you see fit and create your own hired blades raiding party. You are free to create parties of two, three or four mercenaries and change rosters between each dungeon! The choice is yours. Note that the enemy levels will still adapt according to the team you have chosen and the levels of the characters in it. Manage your roster and groups of mercenaries, from the most aggressive to the most cunning, by adapting your strategy to each new dungeon! Each character has its strengths and weaknesses, so make sure to balance your team before you embark on your adventure! 

Being able to switch your party members between scenarios is one of the several necessary steps for us to take on our way to the campaign from the board game. The long-term goal always remains a complete and faithful release of the original board game campaign. The Guildmaster mode and the board game campaign will be two seperate game modes, allowing you to experience two completely different adventures in Gloomhaven Digital.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h2]BIND YOUR ITEMS[/h2]

In the all-new Guildmaster mode, you’ll be able to [b]bind items [/b]to a specific character. 
This prevents you from constantly switching the items between each of your characters, these guys are protective of their gear! Each item will be “bound” when equipped to a mercenary, which is another step towards the campaign mechanics. Please note that to retain flexibility in Guildmaster, you can unbind items for money.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h2]WELCOME YOUR NEW ADVISERS![/h2]

Rest assured that you will not be alone as a guild master, you can count on your new advisers to support you in all the new tasks you will be responsible for, such as organizing your guild members and assigning them different perks and items.
[b]4 new NPCs[/b] have been added in this new mode, allowing you to benefit from their advice throughout your adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/cbd20007ea10c1f30153a396671b92e539262d0d.jpg[/img]

[b]The Trainer[/b]: You can count on the help of the Trainer during an entirely reworked tutorial. He’ll stay by your side during the game, sharing with you the best strategies and more! Moreover, he brings with him all the back end achievement systems, allowing you to unlock specific new missions and rewards by completing set requirements.

[b]The Merchant[/b]: The merchant always has the business acumen! You’re always welcome in his shop. Furthermore, he has traveled a lot and surely knows his way around the region. Now, is he tagging along for money? Probably, yes.

[b]The Enchantress[/b]: Inspired by your desire to rid the region of its ills, this mysterious woman will offer you her services by enhancing your abilities.

[b]The Keeper of the Oak[/b]: She runs the Temple which allows you to be blessed in the next scenario. It is always good to be in the good grace of the gods… 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
We are planning other more detailed posts on the new Guildmaster mode and its many improvements; stay tuned for it! We sincerely hope that these changes delight you! 
Don't forget: see you on June 25 for the arrival of the Guildmaster mode, the Gloomhaven adventure goes on!

notes.title: Become a Guildmaster
notes.content:
[i]“After fighting the most ferocious monsters and the most cunning bandits, after traveling the plains of the continent, you thought you were at the end of your adventures ...

Pressed on the bar, sipping a well-deserved drink, fatigue could be read on your face. Then a hooded figure appeared next to you. Large horns protruded from his hood. With a quick wave of his hand, he ordered a full mug. Without saying a word, he slid a piece of parchment folded in half towards you on the counter.

Arching an eyebrow at the stranger, you grab the paper to discover its contents while the mysterious messenger finishes his glass suddenly and turns on his heels towards the exit.
Your eyes are returned to the parchment. A complete map of the lands of Gloomhaven, showing precisely the location of new equipment, formidable and powerful mercenaries to recruit and more ...

You thought you were at the end of your adventures ... So now discover the new Guildmaster mode!”[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]


Greeting mercenaries! 

As some of you have guessed, we have been working hard lately on a whole new way of adventuring throughout Gloomhaven. Since the release of the early access we have gathered very valuable feedback and requests from your reviews and comments. 

We are delighted to present to you, Gloomhaven Guildmaster: a new game mode coming in the Early Access. It is the largest update so far bringing highly requested changes and new content. Its objective is to both deliver the most gripping & enjoyable early access Gloomhaven experience AND to make a huge step in the direction of the board game campaign implementation. 

Here are few of many changes planned for the Guildmaster update coming on the 25th June:[olist][*] Manage freely your roster of mercenaries at any point of your adventure.
[*] Revamped the out-of-dungeon experience with new missions/objectives/stories. 
[*] Reworked the tutorial and introduction to gameplay mechanics.
[*] Cave biome and its monsters added.
[*] Co-op multiplayer in beta. [/olist]

[previewyoutube=veT3A_YjGII;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h1]GATHER YOUR MERCENARIES AND BECOME A GUILDMASTER[/h1]
As a Guildmaster, you will take control of a Guild of Mercenaries who see an opportunity to make a lot of money by reopening trade routes across the lands while everyone else is too afraid to do it. 
Thanks to the feedback given by our players, we understood that you wanted to be able to actively change your mercenary roster whenever you unlocked a new slot or when we added a new mercenary. 

In the Guildmaster game mode, you will be able to form your own company, modify freely your roster, and try out the best team synergies. 

We also understood that from your comments that the game was lacking objectives and goals as you play. In this update, you will take on over 90 challenging new missions to liberate areas of the map, uncover mercenaries’ stories, unlock powerful items, or simply earn extra gold coins as hired blades. New characters will follow the company in their journey and give out missions and rewards. 

Finally, we received reviews from new players regarding our learning curve and the gap between our tutorial and the in-game experience. 
This is why in the Guildmaster update also brings a reworked tutorial and a well-paced introduction so that newcomers and Gloomhaven experts alike will be able to discover and rediscover the core gameplay mechanics of Gloomhaven, as well as some of the advanced mechanics brought by each mercenary.

A lot of the hidden gameplay mechanics and programming code implemented in this upcoming update brings us closer to the full launch of the board game campaign that includes, but is not limited to: [list][*] Multiplayer co-op mode in beta
[*] Narration in and out of dungeons
[*] Possibility to change rosters
[*] Multiple new dungeon modifiers and objectives
[*] The addition of the Temple
[*] New monsters [/list]

These are just a few examples of features and mechanics that are necessary to achieve one objective: deliver the greatest Gloomhaven digital adaptation with all the original board game content and campaign.


[i]Please note that the guildmaster mode will replace the current adventure mode, therefore your progress will be lost. This is due to the way that the two modes work differently and how progress is measured, unfortunately progression cannot be translated between the two.[/i]


[h1]NEW BIOME: VENTURE OUT IN THE DARK CAVERNS… ![/h1]

A brand new environment has been discovered! 

Prepare to discover the cave biome and its formidable enemies. If fighting a bear is part of your daily activities, beware of the imposing stone golem! Also try not to disturb the sleep of the drakes or vipers. That said, their scales must be worth their weight in gold…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/2d33950cfe11ae0ac6e7161c1527a2cb39edfaf8.jpg[/img]

[h1]CO-OP MULTIPLAYER: CLOSED BETA LAUNCH ON THE 25th JUNE![/h1]

Also we’re not forgetting the multiplayer co-op mode, which is on the top of our priority list. We know you’re very impatient to try it and so are we! 

We’re very pleased to announce that[b] co-op multiplayer will be available in closed beta for a short period on the 25th and will later be released into open beta. [/b]

We've taken the decision to launch it first in closed beta in order to make sure it is stable enough before officially creating a beta branch, where everyone will be able to give it a try. 
If you wish to join the multiplayer co-op closed-beta on the 25th June, you'll have to join our official Discord, where there will be a channel dedicated to this specific closed-beta. 

Click [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/gloomhaven]here[/url] to join the official Gloomhaven discord! 

Please note that these decisions are taken only to provide you with the best experience possible for this very awaited feature! 


[h1]WHAT’S NEXT?[/h1]

This is the largest update so far in the early access bringing both new content and community requested changes and improvements. We’re getting closer to the campaign thanks to these reworks and massive changes. As some of you requested, we have updated the roadmap in order to give you an overview of future updates and content to come. The journey is still on! We still plan to launch the multiplayer mode in Q3, alongside The City update. So stay tuned for more details on that in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/8761c8f1d16143194ff4e50ab78a3624165e5dca.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

So what are your thoughts about the upcoming changes? We can't wait for you to try out all of these new exciting features! We will reveal more and explain further the new game mode to you in the days to come. Stay tuned for the upcoming posts! 


From Gloom, only greed and death emerge...

notes.title: Road Event Writing Contest - Winners announcement!
notes.content:
[i]“A crowd was beginning to gather in front of the billboard of the Sleeping Lion Inn. Mercenaries, bards, and commoners clashed in the hope of distinguishing their written name from the precious piece of parchment placed against the panel. 

You could hear some people jostling, on the verge of drawing fists and swords. Others sighed loudly when they discovered that their text had not been retained. Eventually, you manage to get close enough to catch a glimpse of the names of the proud winners whose adventures would be told beyond the plains of Gloomhaven.”[/i]

[h1]Hello Mercenaries![/h1]

Our writing contest has come to an end! We’d like to thank everyone who tried their luck in this adventure. We loved reading your stories, from the most tragic to the most comical ones. Also, thank you to all the mercenaries who took time to read the entries and give their vote! [b]Now is the time we reveal the winners… [/b]

Congratulations to the following entries:
[list][*] [url=http://www.wishpond.com/ledger_files/1204273/download?api_token=7b44be6e2e16e503e35ca3d1acbcfaf5#A%20Downed%20Traveler.docx]A Downed Traveler[/url]
[*] [url=http://www.wishpond.com/ledger_files/1204475/download?api_token=7b44be6e2e16e503e35ca3d1acbcfaf5#A%20fateful%20encounter.docx]A Fateful Encounter[/url]
[*] [url=http://www.wishpond.com/ledger_files/1204211/download?api_token=7b44be6e2e16e503e35ca3d1acbcfaf5#Gloomhaven%20road%20event%20-%20Bloody%20Valrath.docx]Bloody Valrath[/url][/list]

As a reward and as communicated before, [b]the winners’ shorts stories will be added as Road Events in the digital edition of Gloomhaven![/b]
Your writing skills and the great adventure you have told us will make you an integral part of the tales of Gloomhaven. Your story will be told and sung throughout the lands. 

In order to better fit with the world of Gloomhaven and ensure game balance, we reserve the right to slightly modify and adapt certain passages and rewards so that they are in perfect harmony with other road events. Don’t worry! Any potential changes will be minimal, so as not to taint your work! 
For a reminder, the contest rules can be found [url=https://s3.amazonaws.com/media.wishpond.com/media/014/562/461/original.doc?1582108195]here[/url].

Do not forget that the 10 entries that received the most votes will also be receiving a key for Gloomhaven on Steam. These should have already arrived in your provided email address, so make sure to check if you were one of the top 10!

We really enjoyed spending time reading your writings and running this contest. Thank you all for your involvement and support! Be prepared for more contests and challenges in the future as we continue to improve and enhance the Gloomhaven experience...let’s continue to share more and more adventures in the future! 

The Gloomhaven Team

notes.title: Witness the Power of the Elements!
notes.content:
[Quote=Annals of Gloomhaven][i]The town crier approaches the town square, you stand up from your seat observing the comings and goings in Gloomhaven to find out what is happening. "Hear-ye hear-ye! Many new happenings have been occuring in Gloomhaven in recent times, adventurers and townfolk are advised to keep a watchful eye for strange new creations appearing—rumors state that these are the creations of members of our very own people!" 
You muse to yourself that you would like to learn more about what these new creations are and if you may even be able to create your own inventions...the town crier cuts off your thought as he continues. "A new Mercenary has joined the town's registry and is ready for missions alongside even the most elite adventurers." You contemplate who this new Mercenary might be, and prepare yourself to check the town registry to learn more... "For more details on these happenings, be sure to read our updates on the towns news-board." You re-assess your priorities and first head to the news-board as it is on the way to the town hall.[/i][/quote]

Greetings Mercenaries!

The newest patch for Gloomhaven has now landed on the live servers and we are incredibly excited to see you not only playing with the new Mercenary, now availalable, but also the freshly implemented Modding and Level creation systems, as well as the Enhancements system! 

If your interested in reading the entire patch notes, please see this forum thread: https://steamcommunity.com/app/780290/discussions/0/1643169167151064379/

There is a lot to go over today, so let's get started with the biggest point to discuss, the new Mercenary.

As we know that this is a hot-button topic for the entire community, the below information and reveal of the new Mercenary will be hidden below, under it's icon. If you are not afraid of spoilers, then click the black covered information below. If you want to [b]remain spoiler free[/b], until you have an opportunity to play the game, [b]skip to the next section![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/7b1ee8c3c38b6c492a36ca661715ad73e95f9d19.png[/img]

[spoiler]You have decided to brave this section of spoilers, so let's get down to the four cores of it: The Elementalist is now available in Gloomhaven![/spoiler]

[b]Only watch this trailer if you are not afraid of spoilers:[/b]
[previewyoutube=TjxXSoy0z3M;full][/previewyoutube]

[spoiler]The Elementalist is a Savvas who has attained mastery over the four elements, Fire, Earth, Ice and Air. It is capable of manipulating the elements to an immense degree, generating and using elements of multiple varieties. Be prepared for a class that requires high levels of skill and preperation, capable of both healing and mass devastation![/spoiler]

Now onto another feature that that has been deployed in this patch we're sure is of interest to the entire community: [b]Modding[/b]

[h2]Modding[/h2]
Modding is an advanced feature of the game which we recommend that you learn more about before you start trying to use it. Do note that this is the very [i]first implementation[/i] of modding and we will continue to develop, add to and change the functionality of this system. Modding is an important system for us and something we are taking great care with, so we appreciate any feedback on this system that you may have.

As a word of warning for anyone wanting to use it, do note that there are a high chance of bugs from incorrect YML creation, as well as a chance for corruption of Gloomhaven's data if used incorrectly. The Steam Workshop is integrated into this system to allow simple application of mods and is accessible only if you both own the game and use the "Play with mods" option. Do note as well that not many mods are currently available through the Steam Workshop at this time due to how new the feature is, this will continue to grow and develop over time. 

We have several guides that are of use if you're interested in modding created by a member of the community, as well as by Craig from Flaming Fowl Studios:[list][*] [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Tw9tu5jVtXAXHzd0OfT5M4faS9x7AHN2u2bAmt0QBLg/edit]Craig's starter guide for modding[/url]
[*] [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1cEuwLvCrCY7jV3w1Na8eWPpkX_vD05sJU_XKY9xtxuY/edit]Discord User Lowthor's detailed guide to modding[/url]
[*] [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/gloomhaven]Feel free to head to the Discord Server's modding section for assistance if you encounter any issues.[/url][/list]

While Modding will not allow you to implement new map tiles or character/enemy models, it does allow you to modify the existing rulesets and actions in the game to great effect through the editing of YML files. Several community members have already managed to create some cool mods, but take care as some might spoil future updates and content. We have also implemented a level editor into the game that is accessible in all branches of the game (Play without mods included), which allows you to create customized levels. There is some unreleased content coming in future updates in here, so we caution use of this as there are some stability issues with using this unreleased content and it also risks spoiling some content.

We look forward to everyone getting their hands on all of the new content in this patch!

Good luck in your battles, mercenaries!
